items.qr: (___) no tatta, takitate no gohan.
items.en: Freshly cooked rice with steam rising off it.
items.hi: भाप उठती हुई, ताज़ी पकी हुई चावल।
items.gu: વરાળ ઊઠતા, તાજા બનેલા ભાત.
items.why: 湯気が立つ ("steam rises") is the fixed collocation describing hot food/drink; 生地 refers to fabric or unbaked dough, not vapor.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 3 · 浜辺・雨具・家主

items.q: （ ）と建前を使い分ける。
items.qr: (___) to tatemae o tsukaiwakeru.
items.en: To switch between one's real feelings and one's public stance as needed.
items.hi: असली मंशा और दिखावटी रुख़ को हालात के हिसाब से बदलना।
items.gu: સાચી લાગણી અને દેખાડાનું વલણ પરિસ્થિતિ પ્રમાણે બદલવું.

opts.en: a tone (of an instrument, wrong pairing)

items.why: 本音と建前 ("real feelings vs. public façade") is one of the most famous fixed pairs in Japanese social vocabulary. 音色 describes a musical tone and has no relation to 建前.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 3 · 浜辺・雨具・家主

items.q: （ ）の時報とともに、休憩する。
items.qr: (___) no jihou to tomo ni, kyuukei suru.
items.en: (We/They) take a break at the noon time signal.
items.hi: दोपहर के समय-संकेत के साथ ही विश्राम करते हैं।
items.gu: બપોરના સમય-સંકેત સાથે જ આરામ કરે છે.
items.why: 正午の時報 (the noon siren/time signal) is a real daily custom in Japan; 夜明け (dawn) has no equivalent fixed "time signal" phrase.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 3 · 浜辺・雨具・家主

items.q: 夫が見るテレビ番組は、（ ）ニュースです。
items.qr: Otto ga miru terebi bangumi wa, (___) nyuusu desu.
items.en: The TV programs my husband watches are exclusively the news.
items.hi: मेरे पति जो टीवी कार्यक्रम देखते हैं, वे सिर्फ़ समाचार होते हैं।
items.gu: મારા પતિ જે ટીવી કાર્યક્રમો જુએ છે તે ફક્ત સમાચાર જ હોય છે.
items.why: 専ら ("exclusively/mainly") describes what someone watches almost without exception. 自ら means "(one)self, personally" and describes who performs an action, not how exclusive a habit is.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 3 · 浜辺・雨具・家主

items.q: 景気は回復の（ ）を見せている。
items.qr: Keiki wa kaifuku no (___) o misete iru.
items.en: The economy is showing signs of recovery.
items.hi: अर्थव्यवस्था में सुधार के संकेत दिख रहे हैं।
items.gu: અર્થતંત્રમાં સુધારાના સંકેત દેખાઈ રહ્યા છે.
items.why: 回復の兆し ("signs of recovery") is the fixed collocation for early indicators of a trend; 炎 (a flame) is unrelated to economic indicators.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 3 · 浜辺・雨具・家主

items.q: （ ）のように車が何台もつながって、なかなか進まない。
items.qr: (___) no you ni kuruma ga nandai mo tsunagatte, nakanaka susumanai.
items.en: Cars are strung together like prayer beads and barely moving forward.
items.hi: मालाओं की तरह कई गाड़ियाँ आपस में जुड़ी हैं और मुश्किल से आगे बढ़ रही हैं।
items.gu: જપમાળાની જેમ ઘણી ગાડીઓ જોડાયેલી છે અને માંડ માંડ આગળ વધે છે.
items.why: 数珠つなぎ ("strung together like prayer beads") is the fixed simile for a long, connected line of things — exactly bumper-to-bumper traffic. 小豆 (adzuki beans) isn't part of this idiom.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 4 · 田舎・景色・迷子

items.q: （ ）のお子さんをお預かりしています。お心当たりの方は……
items.qr: (___) no okosan o oazukari shite imasu. Okokoroatari no kata wa...
items.en: We are looking after a lost child. If this sounds familiar to you...
items.hi: हम एक खोए हुए बच्चे की देखभाल कर रहे हैं। यदि आपको इसकी जानकारी हो...
items.gu: અમે એક ખોવાયેલા બાળકની સંભાળ રાખી રહ્યા છીએ. જો તમને આ અંગે ખ્યાલ હોય તો...

opts.en: whereabouts (not a noun describing a child)

items.why: 迷子 directly means "a lost child" — the exact noun this public announcement needs. 行方 means "whereabouts" and cannot itself describe a person.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 4 · 田舎・景色・迷子

items.q: （ ）惜しいのですが、そろそろお別れの時間です。
items.qr: (___) oshii no desu ga, sorosoro owakare no jikan desu.
items.en: I'm sad to part, but it's about time to say goodbye.
items.hi: जाने का मन नहीं है, पर अब विदा लेने का समय हो गया है।
items.gu: છૂટા પડવાનું મન નથી થતું, પણ હવે વિદાયનો સમય થઈ ગયો છે.
items.why: 名残惜しい ("reluctant to part, wistful") is a fixed phrase for feeling sad about an ending. 最寄 means "nearest" (usually of a location) and doesn't combine with 惜しい.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 4 · 田舎・景色・迷子

items.q: いいお天気で、洗濯（ ）です。
items.qr: Ii otenki de, sentaku (___) desu.
items.en: With such nice weather, it's perfect laundry-drying weather.
items.hi: मौसम इतना अच्छा है, कपड़े सुखाने के लिए एकदम सही दिन है।
items.gu: હવામાન એટલું સરસ છે કે કપડાં સૂકવવા માટે એકદમ યોગ્ય દિવસ છે.
items.why: 洗濯日和 ("perfect laundry weather") is a fixed collocation pattern (X日和 = "great conditions for X"). 浴衣 is an article of clothing and has no such usage.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 4 · 田舎・景色・迷子

items.q: 交番の（ ）に道をたずねる。
items.qr: Kouban no (___) ni michi o tazuneru.
items.en: To ask the police-box officer for directions.
items.hi: पुलिस चौकी के सिपाही से रास्ता पूछना।
items.gu: પોલીસ ચોકીના પોલીસવાળાને રસ્તો પૂછવો.
items.why: 交番 (a police box) is staffed by お巡りさん, who give directions. お仲人さん arranges marriages and has no connection to a police box.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 4 · 田舎・景色・迷子

items.q: やっと（ ）が明けたようだ。
items.qr: Yatto (___) ga aketa you da.
items.en: It seems the rainy season has finally ended.
items.hi: लगता है आख़िरकार बरसात का मौसम ख़त्म हो गया है।
items.gu: લાગે છે કે આખરે ચોમાસું પૂરું થયું છે.
items.why: 梅雨が明ける ("the rainy season ends/clears up") is the fixed seasonal phrase. 雪崩 (an avalanche) collocates with 起きる/巻き込まれる (occurs/gets caught in), never 明ける.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 4 · 田舎・景色・迷子

items.q: 金メダルが取れた（ ）で、ゆうべは眠れませんでした。
items.qr: Kin medaru ga toreta (___) de, yuube wa nemuremasen deshita.
items.en: I couldn't sleep last night from the excitement of winning the gold medal.
items.hi: स्वर्ण पदक जीतने की उत्तेजना के कारण मैं कल रात सो नहीं पाया/पाई।
items.gu: ગોલ્ડ મેડલ જીતવાની ઉત્તેજનાને કારણે ગઈકાલે રાત્રે ઊંઘ ન આવી.
items.why: 興奮で眠れない ("too excited to sleep") is a natural cause-and-effect; 余興 refers to a supplementary performance/entertainment at an event and has no "keeping you awake" sense.

items.q: （ ）お時間をいただきまして、ありがとうございます。
items.qr: (___) o-jikan o itadakimashite, arigatou gozaimasu.
items.en: Thank you for your valuable time.
items.hi: आपके क़ीमती समय के लिए धन्यवाद।
items.gu: તમારા મૂલ્યવાન સમય માટે આભાર.

opts.en: respect (尊重 doesn't take な this way)

items.why: 貴重なお時間 ("your valuable time") is the standard polite fixed phrase. 尊重 normally appears as 尊重する (to respect) or 尊重されるべき, not as a plain 尊重な adjective before a noun like 時間.

items.q: （ ）する会社との争いが激しくなってきた。
items.qr: (___) suru kaisha to no arasoi ga hageshiku natte kita.
items.en: The rivalry with competing companies has intensified.
items.hi: प्रतिस्पर्धी कंपनियों के साथ होड़ तेज़ होती जा रही है।
items.gu: સ્પર્ધક કંપનીઓ સાથેની હરીફાઈ તીવ્ર બની રહી છે.
items.why: 競合する会社 ("a rival/competing company") directly matches "争い" (conflict/rivalry). 貿易する会社 just means "a company that trades" and carries no built-in sense of rivalry.

items.q: 車にはいろいろな安全（ ）がついています。
items.qr: Kuruma ni wa iroiro na anzen (___) ga tsuite imasu.
items.en: The car comes with various safety devices.
items.hi: कार में कई तरह के सुरक्षा उपकरण लगे हुए हैं।
items.gu: કારમાં અનેક પ્રકારનાં સલામતી ઉપકરણો લગાડેલાં છે.
items.why: 安全装置 ("safety device/mechanism") is the fixed technical term. 衣装 refers to clothing/costumes and has no place in a car.

items.q: 文字や記号の表記を（ ）する。
items.qr: Moji ya kigou no hyouki o (___) suru.
items.en: To standardize the notation of characters and symbols.
items.hi: अक्षरों और चिह्नों की लेखन-शैली को एक समान बनाना।
items.gu: અક્ષરો અને ચિહ્નોની લેખન-શૈલીને એકસમાન બનાવવી.

opts.en: identical (a state, not a verb of standardizing)

items.why: 表記を統一する ("unify/standardize the notation") is the natural collocation for making a style consistent. 同一 describes two things already being identical/the same — it doesn't function as "to make consistent" in this construction.

items.q: その場は（ ）なムードに包まれた。
items.qr: Sono ba wa (___) na muudo ni tsutsumareta.
items.en: The scene was enveloped in a hostile/tense mood.
items.hi: वहाँ का माहौल तनावपूर्ण/शत्रुतापूर्ण हो गया।
items.gu: ત્યાંનું વાતાવરણ તંગ/પ્રતિકૂળ બની ગયું.

opts.en: hatred (a noun, not this adjectival use)

items.why: 険悪なムード ("a tense/hostile mood/atmosphere") is the fixed adjectival phrase for describing tension in a room. 憎悪 is a strong noun for deep hatred and doesn't naturally describe an ambient mood this way.

items.q: チャンピオンも強かったが、さらに上手の挑戦者がいた。
items.qr: Chanpion mo tsuyokatta ga, sara ni joute no chousensha ga ita.
items.en: The champion was strong too, but there was an even more skilled challenger.
items.hi: चैंपियन भी मज़बूत था, पर एक और भी बेहतर चुनौती देने वाला मौजूद था।
items.gu: ચેમ્પિયન પણ મજબૂત હતો, પણ એક વધુ કુશળ પડકારનાર હાજર હતો.
items.why: Comparing skill levels between two competitors calls for うわて ("someone better/superior"); かみて only applies to describing stage position, which is irrelevant here.

items.q: その件については目下検討中です。
items.qr: Sono ken ni tsuite wa mokka kentouchuu desu.
items.en: That matter is currently under consideration.
items.hi: उस मामले पर फ़िलहाल विचार किया जा रहा है।
items.gu: તે બાબત પર હાલમાં વિચારણા ચાલી રહી છે.
items.why: 目下検討中 ("currently under review") uses もっか ("at present"); めした describes a person's subordinate rank and cannot modify "under consideration."

items.q: 分別のある人なら、そんなことはしないはずだ。
items.qr: (___) no aru hito nara, sonna koto wa shinai hazu da.
items.en: Someone with good sense/discretion wouldn't do such a thing.
items.hi: जिसमें विवेक होगा, वह ऐसा नहीं करेगा।
items.gu: જેનામાં વિવેક હોય તે આવું ન કરે.
items.why: 分別のある人 ("a person of discretion/good judgment") uses ふんべつ; ぶんべつ describes sorting physical items (like garbage) and cannot describe a person's character.

items.q: 色紙に一言ずつみんなでお別れの言葉を書く。
items.qr: (___) ni hitokoto zutsu minna de owakare no kotoba o kaku.
items.en: Everyone writes a farewell message on the autograph board, one line each.
items.hi: सब लोग ऑटोग्राफ़ बोर्ड पर एक-एक पंक्ति विदाई संदेश लिखते हैं।
items.gu: બધા ઓટોગ્રાફ બોર્ડ પર એક-એક લીટી વિદાય સંદેશ લખે છે.

opts.en: coloured paper (wrong object for farewell messages)

items.why: Group farewell messages in Japan are traditionally written on a 色紙 read しきし (a stiff square autograph board), not on いろがみ (ordinary coloured craft paper).

items.q: 生物ですから、なるべく早くお召し上がりください。
items.qr: (___) desu kara, narubeku hayaku omeshiagari kudasai.
items.en: Since this is perishable, please eat it as soon as possible.
items.hi: यह जल्दी ख़राब होने वाला है, इसलिए कृपया इसे जल्द से जल्द खा लें।
items.gu: આ ઝડપથી બગડે તેવું છે, તેથી કૃપા કરી વહેલી તકે ખાઈ લો.

opts.en: living things in general (wrong sense here)

items.why: A food-safety label reading "eat soon" refers to なまもの (perishable food); せいぶつ is the biology term for living organisms in general and doesn't fit a food label.

items.q: オランダと言えば、風車小屋とチューリップが思い浮かぶ。
items.qr: Oranda to ieba, (___) koya to churippu ga omoiukabu.
items.en: Speaking of the Netherlands, windmills and tulips come to mind.
items.hi: नीदरलैंड्स की बात करें तो पवनचक्कियाँ और ट्यूलिप याद आते हैं।
items.gu: નેધરલેન્ડ્સની વાત આવે ત્યારે પવનચક્કીઓ અને ટ્યૂલિપ યાદ આવે છે.
items.why: 風車小屋 ("a windmill building/mill") describing the Netherlands' iconic landscape is ふうしゃ; かざぐるま refers to a small handheld paper pinwheel toy, not a building.

items.q: 社員募集。経験の有無は問いません。
items.qr: Shain boshuu. Keiken no umu wa toimasen.
items.en: Now hiring. Whether or not you have experience doesn't matter.
items.hi: कर्मचारी भर्ती। अनुभव है या नहीं, इससे फ़र्क़ नहीं पड़ता।
items.gu: કર્મચારી ભરતી. અનુભવ છે કે નહીં, તેનાથી ફરક પડતો નથી.
items.why: 有無 always reads うむ; the other options aren't valid readings of this compound.

items.q: 吹雪の後、雪崩が起きた。
items.qr: Fubuki no ato, nadare ga okita.
items.en: After the snowstorm, an avalanche occurred.
items.hi: बर्फ़ीले तूफ़ान के बाद, हिमस्खलन हुआ।
items.gu: બરફના તોફાન પછી, હિમપ્રપાત થયો.
items.why: 吹雪 reads ふぶき; none of the other choices are valid readings.

items.q: 差し支えなければ、ご住所を教えていただけませんか。
items.qr: Sashitsukae nakereba, go-juusho o oshiete itadakemasen ka.
items.en: If it's no trouble, could you tell me your address?
items.hi: अगर कोई परेशानी न हो, तो क्या आप अपना पता बता सकते हैं?
items.gu: જો કોઈ તકલીફ ન હોય, તો શું તમે તમારું સરનામું જણાવી શકશો?
items.why: 差し支える reads さしつかえる; no other option is a real reading of this word.

items.q: 江戸時代の情緒が残る町並みを歩く。
items.qr: Edo jidai no jouchou ga nokoru machinami o aruku.
items.en: To walk through a townscape that retains the atmosphere of the Edo period.
items.hi: एदो काल का माहौल बरक़रार रखने वाली गलियों में चलना।
items.gu: એદો કાળનું વાતાવરણ જાળવી રાખતી શેરીઓમાં ચાલવું.
items.why: 情緒 reads じょうちょ; ふぜい is a genuine Japanese word but belongs to a different kanji (風情), not this one.

items.q: 世間体を気にしないで思い通りに生きる。
items.qr: Sekentei o ki ni shinai de omoidoori ni ikiru.
items.en: To live as one pleases without worrying about appearances.
items.hi: लोगों की परवाह किए बिना अपनी मर्ज़ी से जीना।
items.gu: લોકોની પરવા કર્યા વગર પોતાની મરજી પ્રમાણે જીવવું.
items.why: 世間体 reads せけんてい; the other options aren't valid readings.

items.q: 私は日本の相撲に興味があります。
items.qr: Watashi wa nihon no sumou ni kyoumi ga arimasu.
items.en: I'm interested in Japanese sumo.
items.hi: मुझे जापानी सूमो में दिलचस्पी है।
items.gu: મને જાપાની સૂમોમાં રસ છે.
items.why: 興味 reads きょうみ; しゅみ is a real word ("a hobby") but is written 趣味, a different kanji.

items.q: もう少し効率のいいやり方はないのだろうか。
items.qr: Mou sukoshi kouritsu no ii yarikata wa nai no darou ka.
items.en: Isn't there a somewhat more efficient way of doing this?
items.hi: क्या इससे थोड़ा और बेहतर, दक्ष तरीक़ा नहीं है?
items.gu: શું આના કરતાં થોડી વધુ કાર્યક્ષમ રીત નથી?
items.why: 効率 reads こうりつ; こうそつ mixes up 率's two readings — ソツ belongs to 軽率/統率, not 効率.

items.q: 首相は発言の事実を否定した。
items.qr: Shushou wa hatsugen no jijitsu o hitei shita.
items.en: The prime minister denied having made the remark.
items.hi: प्रधानमंत्री ने अपने बयान के तथ्य से इनकार किया।
items.gu: વડાપ્રધાને પોતાના નિવેદનની હકીકતનો ઇનકાર કર્યો.
items.why: 発言 reads はつげん; 発's irregular ホツ reading is specific to words like 発作/発足/発起 (Day 2), not 発言.

items.q: 日本の先端技術や美意識を紹介する。
items.qr: Nihon no sentan gijutsu ya biishiki o shoukai suru.
items.en: To introduce Japan's cutting-edge technology and aesthetic sensibility.
items.hi: जापान की अत्याधुनिक तकनीक और सौंदर्यबोध का परिचय देना।
items.gu: જાપાનની અત્યાધુનિક ટેકનોલોજી અને સૌંદર્યબોધનો પરિચય આપવો.
items.why: 先端 reads せんたん; the other options aren't valid readings.

items.q: 大掃除は天井から始めよう。
items.qr: Ousouji wa tenjou kara hajimeyou.
items.en: Let's start the big cleaning from the ceiling.
items.hi: बड़ी सफ़ाई छत से शुरू करते हैं।
items.gu: મોટી સફાઈ છત્તથી શરૂ કરીએ.
items.why: 天井 reads てんじょう; the other options aren't valid readings.

items.q: 名前のかしらもじを書く。
items.qr: Namae no kashiramoji o kaku.
items.en: To write the initials of one's name.
items.hi: नाम के आद्याक्षर लिखना।
items.gu: નામના આદ્યાક્ષર લખવા.
items.why: かしらもじ is written 頭文字; 顔文字/絵文字 are unrelated real words that merely look similar.

items.q: いっこだてに住む。
items.qr: Ikkodate ni sumu.
items.en: To live in a detached house.
items.hi: स्वतंत्र मकान में रहना।
items.gu: સ્વતંત્ર મકાનમાં રહેવું.
items.why: いっこだて is written 一戸建て — 戸 (a household/door), not 個 (a generic counter), and 建て (built), not 立て (stood up).

items.q: かいがを見に行く。
items.qr: Kaiga o mi ni iku.
items.en: To go see a painting/art exhibition.
items.hi: चित्रकला देखने जाना।
items.gu: ચિત્રકળા જોવા જવું.
items.why: かいが is written 絵画; 階下/開花 both read かいか (one syllable short) and 海外 reads かいがい (one syllable long) — close but different words.

items.q: 店の前に長いぎょうれつができた。
items.qr: Mise no mae ni nagai gyouretsu ga dekita.
items.en: A long line formed in front of the store.
items.hi: दुकान के सामने लंबी कतार लग गई।
items.gu: દુકાનની આગળ લાંબી કતાર લાગી ગઈ.
items.why: ぎょうれつ is written 行列; 系列 is a real but unrelated word (a corporate affiliation group) read けいれつ.

items.q: 傘のえに名前を書いた。
items.qr: Kasa no e ni namae o kaita.
items.en: I wrote my name on the umbrella's handle.
items.hi: मैंने छाते की मूठ पर अपना नाम लिखा।
items.gu: મેં છત્રીના હાથા પર મારું નામ લખ્યું.
items.why: An umbrella's handle (傘の柄) is written 柄, read え in this word — the same kanji whose other readings (へい/がら) appeared on Day 1.

items.q: 家族連れが海（ ）で楽しそうに遊んでいる。
items.qr: Kazokuzure ga umi(___) de tanoshisou ni asonde iru.
items.en: Families are happily playing at the seaside.
items.hi: परिवार समुद्रतट पर ख़ुशी-ख़ुशी खेल रहे हैं।
items.gu: પરિવારો દરિયાકિનારે ખુશીથી રમી રહ્યા છે.
items.why: 海辺 (umibe, "the seaside") was named directly on Day 3 as a related form of 浜辺 (hamabe, "a beach").

items.q: この野菜には（ ）毒作用がある。
items.qr: Kono yasai ni wa (___)doku sayou ga aru.
items.en: This vegetable has a detoxifying effect.
items.hi: इस सब्ज़ी में विषहरण करने का गुण है।
items.gu: આ શાકભાજીમાં વિષહરણ કરવાનો ગુણ છે.
items.why: 解毒 (げどく, "detoxification") is Day 5's own word; none of the other kanji forms a real "___毒" compound with this meaning.

items.q: このところ不調だった投手が今日は好投し、（ ）名を返上した。
items.qr: Kono tokoro fuchou datta toushu ga kyou wa koutou shi, (___)mei o henjou shita.
items.en: The pitcher, who had been struggling lately, pitched well today and cleared his tarnished name.
items.hi: हाल ही में ख़राब फ़ॉर्म में रहे गेंदबाज़ ने आज अच्छी गेंदबाज़ी करके अपनी बदनामी मिटाई।
items.gu: તાજેતરમાં નબળા ફોર્મમાં રહેલા બોલરે આજે સારો બોલિંગ કરીને પોતાની બદનામી દૂર કરી.
items.why: 汚名返上 (おめいへんじょう, "clearing one's tarnished name") is the fixed four-character phrase introduced on Day 2.

items.q: 面接のスーツの色は紺、グレー、黒などが（ ）難でしょう。
items.qr: Mensetsu no suutsu no iro wa kon, guree, kuro nado ga (___)nan deshou.
items.en: For an interview suit, colors like navy, gray, or black are probably a safe choice.
items.hi: इंटरव्यू के सूट के लिए, नेवी, ग्रे या काला रंग शायद सुरक्षित विकल्प होंगे।
items.gu: ઇન્ટરવ્યુના સૂટ માટે, નેવી, ગ્રે અથવા કાળો રંગ કદાચ સલામત વિકલ્પ હશે.
items.why: 無難 (ぶなん, "safe, unobjectionable") is Day 5's own word, and fits "a safe/inoffensive suit color" exactly.

items.q: 「芝生に入るな」という立て（ ）が見えませんか。
items.qr: "Shibafu ni hairu na" to iu tate(___) ga miemasen ka.
items.en: Can't you see the sign that says "Keep off the grass"?
items.hi: क्या आपको "घास पर मत चलो" लिखी तख़्ती नहीं दिख रही?
items.gu: શું તમને "ઘાસ પર ન ચાલો" લખેલું પાટિયું દેખાતું નથી?
items.why: 立て札 (たてふだ, "a signboard") is Day 6's own word — the same 札 that also reads さつ for money.

items.q: （a.空き巣 b.鳥の巣）が入らないように戸締まりに注意する。
items.qr: (a. Akisu b. Tori no su) ga hairanai you ni tojimari ni chuui suru.
items.en: Be careful to lock up so that a sneak thief doesn't get in.
items.hi: ध्यान रखें कि सेंधमार अंदर न आ सके, इसलिए दरवाज़े-खिड़कियाँ बंद कर लें।
items.gu: ઘરફોડ ચોર અંદર ન આવે તે માટે બારીબારણાં બંધ રાખવાનું ધ્યાન રાખો.

opts.en: bird nest (doesn't "get in" through locked doors)

items.why: 戸締まり (locking up doors/windows) is a home-security context, which matches 空き巣 (a burglar); 鳥の巣 is a literal bird's nest and has nothing to do with locking a house.

items.q: 暗かったが、確かに（a.物陰 b.人影）を見た。
items.qr: Kurakatta ga, tashika ni (a. monokage b. hitokage) o mita.
items.en: It was dark, but I definitely saw a human silhouette.
items.hi: अंधेरा था, पर मैंने वाक़ई किसी इंसान की परछाईं देखी।
items.gu: અંધારું હતું, પણ મેં ચોક્કસ કોઈ વ્યક્તિનો પડછાયો જોયો.
items.why: The verb 見た (saw) needs an object you can visually see — 人影 (the shape of a person) fits; 物陰 names a location (behind something), not a thing you "see" directly.

items.q: 彼女は（a.口が堅い b.頭が固い）から何でも相談できる。
items.qr: Kanojo wa (a. kuchi ga katai b. atama ga katai) kara nandemo soudan dekiru.
items.en: She keeps secrets, so I can consult her about anything.
items.hi: वह राज़दार है, इसलिए मैं उससे कुछ भी सलाह ले सकता/सकती हूँ।
items.gu: તે રહસ્ય જાળવે છે, એટલે હું તેની સાથે કંઈ પણ સલાહ-મસલત કરી શકું છું.
items.why: Being consultable about "anything" depends on trusting her not to leak secrets — 口が堅い (tight-lipped); 頭が固い describes a stubborn, closed-minded person, which would make her a worse confidant, not a better one.

items.q: 秘書の仕事は（a.気が荒い b.気が利く）人でなければできないだろう。
items.qr: Hisho no shigoto wa (a. ki ga arai b. ki ga kiku) hito de nakereba dekinai darou.
items.en: A secretary's job probably can't be done except by someone who is smart and considerate.
items.hi: सचिव का काम शायद केवल वही कर सकता है जो समझदार और ख़याल रखने वाला हो।
items.gu: સેક્રેટરીનું કામ કદાચ ફક્ત તે જ કરી શકે જે સમજદાર અને ખ્યાલ રાખનારું હોય.
items.why: A good secretary needs tact and quick thinking — 気が利く; 気が荒い (a rough temper) is the opposite of a quality you'd want in that role.

items.q: もう来ないかと思ったころに、やっと彼は（a.姿を現した b.正体を現した）。
items.qr: Mou konai ka to omotta koro ni, yatto kare wa (a. sugata o arawashita b. shoutai o arawashita).
items.en: Just when we thought he wasn't coming, he finally showed up.
items.hi: जब हमें लगने लगा था कि वह अब नहीं आएगा, तभी आख़िरकार वह सामने आ गया।
items.gu: જ્યારે લાગવા લાગ્યું કે તે નહીં આવે, ત્યારે છેવટે તે પ્રગટ થયો.
items.why: Someone simply arriving late is 姿を現す (to appear/show up); 正体を現す is reserved for unmasking a hidden or disguised true identity — a much more dramatic meaning than "finally arrived."

items.q: （a.効き目 b.網の目）が粗いと、小さい魚は捕れない。
items.qr: (a. Kikime b. Ami no me) ga arai to, chiisai sakana wa torenai.
items.en: If the mesh of the net is coarse, you can't catch small fish.
items.hi: अगर जाल का जाला मोटा (बड़े छेद वाला) हो, तो छोटी मछलियाँ नहीं पकड़ी जा सकतीं।
items.gu: જો જાળના કાણાં મોટા હોય, તો નાની માછલીઓ પકડી શકાતી નથી.
items.why: 粗い (coarse) modifying a physical mesh size only makes sense with 網の目 (the net's mesh); 効き目 (effectiveness) isn't something that can be physically "coarse."

items.q: 優秀な成績を（a.修める b.努める）。
items.qr: Yuushuu na seiseki o (a. osameru b. tsutomeru).
items.en: To achieve excellent grades.
items.hi: उत्कृष्ट अंक/परिणाम हासिल करना।
items.gu: ઉત્કૃષ્ટ ગુણ/પરિણામ મેળવવા.

opts.en: to strive/make an effort (wrong verb for a result)

items.why: 成績を修める is the set collocation for "achieving/earning grades" as a completed result; 努める describes the ongoing effort itself, not the achieved outcome.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 2 · 絶える・耐える・堪える

items.q: ご報告があって、筆を（a.執りました b.討ちました）。
items.qr: Go-houkoku ga atte, fude o (a. torimashita b. uchimashita).
items.en: Having something to report, I took up my pen (to write it).
items.hi: कुछ रिपोर्ट करना था, इसलिए मैंने कलम उठाई।
items.gu: કંઈક જણાવવાનું હતું, એટલે મેં કલમ ઉપાડી.
items.why: 筆を執る〈執筆〉is the fixed phrase for "taking up the pen to write"; 討つ means to attack or defeat an enemy and has no connection to writing.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 2 · 絶える・耐える・堪える

items.q: 秋の美しい空を（a.仰ぐ b.澄む）。
items.qr: Aki no utsukushii sora o (a. aogu b. sumu).
items.en: To look up at the beautiful autumn sky.
items.hi: पतझड़ के ख़ूबसूरत आसमान की ओर देखना।
items.gu: પાનખરના સુંદર આકાશ તરફ જોવું.
items.why: 空を仰ぐ (looking up at the sky) needs 仰ぐ, a transitive "to gaze upward at" verb; 澄む describes the sky/water becoming clear on its own and can't take 空を as its direct object here.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 2 · 絶える・耐える・堪える

items.q: ドラマの主役を（a.納める b.務める）。
items.qr: Dorama no shuyaku o (a. osameru b. tsutomeru).
items.en: To play the leading role in a drama.
items.hi: धारावाहिक में मुख्य भूमिका निभाना।
items.gu: નાટકમાં મુખ્ય ભૂમિકા ભજવવી.

opts.en: to pay/supply (wrong verb for a role)

items.why: 主役を務める is the set phrase for "playing a leading role"; 納める is used for paying taxes or supplying goods, not for a theatrical role.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 2 · 絶える・耐える・堪える

items.q: 駅までの道を（a.謝る b.尋ねる）。
items.qr: Eki made no michi o (a. ayamaru b. tazuneru).
items.en: To ask the way to the station.
items.hi: स्टेशन जाने का रास्ता पूछना।
items.gu: સ્ટેશન સુધીનો રસ્તો પૂછવો.
items.why: 道を尋ねる is the standard phrase for "asking the way"; 謝る (to apologize) doesn't fit at all — a common trap purely because 謝る and 尋ねる look similar in kana-stripped test formatting.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 2 · 絶える・耐える・堪える

items.q: 選択を（a.耐えた b.誤った）。
items.qr: Sentaku o (a. taeta b. ayamatta).
items.en: Made a wrong choice.
items.hi: ग़लत चुनाव किया।
items.gu: ખોટી પસંદગી કરી.
items.why: 選択を誤る is the set phrase for "making a wrong choice"; 耐える means to endure hardship and cannot take 選択 (a choice) as its object.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 2 · 絶える・耐える・堪える

items.q: 磁石の針が北の方向を（a.指して b.計って）いる。
items.qr: Jishaku no hari ga kita no houkou o (a. sashite b. hakatte) iru.
items.en: The compass needle is pointing north.
items.hi: कम्पास की सुई उत्तर दिशा दिखा रही है।
items.gu: હોકાયંત્રની સોય ઉત્તર દિશા બતાવી રહી છે.
items.why: 北を指す is the fixed phrase for a needle/arrow "pointing" at a direction; 計る is for measuring counts or time, not indicating direction.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 3 · 攻める・責める

items.q: 自ら命を（a.絶つ b.犯す）若者が増えている。
items.qr: Mizukara inochi o (a. tatsu b. okasu) wakamono ga fuete iru.
items.en: The number of young people who take their own lives is increasing.
items.hi: अपनी जान लेने वाले युवाओं की संख्या बढ़ रही है।
items.gu: પોતાનો જીવ લેનારા યુવાનોની સંખ્યા વધી રહી છે.
items.why: 命を絶つ is the set phrase for ending one's own life; 犯す pairs with 罪 (a crime) or 法 (a law), not with 命 (a life).
items.unit: Week 5 Day 3 · 攻める・責める

items.q: 「反対」と答えた人が過半数を（a.締めて b.占めて）いる。
items.qr: "Hantai" to kotaeta hito ga kahansuu o (a. shimete b. shimete) iru.
items.en: Those who answered "opposed" make up a majority.
items.hi: "विरोध में" जवाब देने वाले लोग बहुमत में हैं।
items.gu: "વિરોધ" જવાબ આપનારા લોકો બહુમતીમાં છે.
items.why: 過半数を占める is the fixed phrase for "constitute/make up a majority"; 締める is for physically fastening (a belt, a lid), not for statistical proportions — both share the reading しめる.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 3 · 攻める・責める

items.q: 金を渡して便宜を（a.図る b.謀る）よう指示した。
items.qr: Kane o watashite bengi o (a. hakaru b. hakaru) you shiji shita.
items.en: He instructed [them] to hand over money and arrange favorable treatment.
items.hi: उसने पैसे देकर सुविधा दिलवाने का निर्देश दिया।
items.gu: તેણે પૈસા આપીને સગવડ કરાવવાની સૂચના આપી.
items.why: 便宜を図る is the book's own fixed phrase for "arranging convenience/favorable treatment"; 謀る is reserved for plotting something like an assassination or coup, and doesn't collocate with 便宜.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 3 · 攻める・責める

items.q: 仕事が忙しすぎて家庭を（a.省みる b.顧みる）余裕がない。
items.qr: Shigoto ga isogashi-sugite katei o (a. kaerimiru b. kaerimiru) yoyuu ga nai.
items.en: Work is too busy to leave any room to attend to family.
items.hi: काम इतना व्यस्त है कि परिवार की तरफ़ ध्यान देने की गुंजाइश ही नहीं है।
items.gu: કામ એટલું વ્યસ્ત છે કે કુટુંબ તરફ ધ્યાન આપવાની ફુરસદ જ નથી.
items.why: 家庭を顧みる (attending to one's family) is the book's own listed phrase; 省みる is reserved for self-reflection on one's own conduct, not for "attending to" an external thing like family.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 3 · 攻める・責める

items.q: 難病に（a.侵され b.絞められ）ながらも強く生きぬく人々がいる。
items.qr: Nanbyou ni (a. okasare b. shimerare) nagara mo tsuyoku ikinuku hitobito ga iru.
items.en: There are people who live on strongly even while afflicted with an intractable disease.
items.hi: असाध्य बीमारी से ग्रस्त होते हुए भी दृढ़ता से जीने वाले लोग हैं।
items.gu: અસાધ્ય બીમારીથી પીડિત હોવા છતાં મક્કમતાથી જીવનારા લોકો છે.
items.why: 難病に侵される is the set phrase for a disease invading/afflicting the body; 絞める means to physically strangle, which has no place here.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 3 · 攻める・責める

items.q: （a.細菌 b.最近）を培養して研究する。
items.qr: (a. Saikin b. Saikin) o baiyou shite kenkyuu suru.
items.en: Culture bacteria and study them.
items.hi: जीवाणुओं का संवर्धन (कल्चर) करके उन पर शोध करना।
items.gu: બેક્ટેરિયાનું સંવર્ધન કરીને તેના પર સંશોધન કરવું.

opts.en: recently (an adverb, not a lab specimen)

items.why: Only 細菌 (bacteria) is something you can 培養する (culture) in a lab; 最近 means "recently" and cannot be the object of "culture and study."

items.q: 社会（a.補償 b.保障）制度の見直しをする。
items.qr: Shakai (a. hoshou b. hoshou) seido no minaoshi o suru.
items.en: Review the social security system.
items.hi: सामाजिक सुरक्षा प्रणाली की समीक्षा करना।
items.gu: સામાજિક સુરક્ષા વ્યવસ્થાની સમીક્ષા કરવી.
items.why: 社会保障 (social security) is the fixed institutional term; 補償 refers to paying compensation for a specific loss or damage, not a welfare system.

items.q: 携帯電話の使用が会議の（a.進行 b.振興）を妨げた。
items.qr: Keitai denwa no shiyou ga kaigi no (a. shinkou b. shinkou) o samatageta.
items.en: Cellphone use hindered the meeting's progress.
items.hi: मोबाइल फ़ोन के इस्तेमाल ने बैठक की प्रगति में बाधा डाली।
items.gu: મોબાઈલ ફોનના ઉપયોગે બેઠકની પ્રગતિમાં અડચણ ઊભી કરી.
items.why: 会議の進行 (the meeting's proceeding) is what phones would disrupt; 振興 means promoting the development of something (a town, an industry), unrelated to running a meeting.

items.q: 若手議員は政界の世代（a.交代 b.新興）の必要性を訴えた。
items.qr: Wakate giin wa seikai no sedai (a. koutai b. shinkou) no hitsuyousei o uttaeta.
items.en: The young lawmaker argued for the need for generational change in politics.
items.hi: युवा सांसद ने राजनीति में पीढ़ी परिवर्तन की ज़रूरत पर ज़ोर दिया।
items.gu: યુવાન સાંસદે રાજકારણમાં પેઢી પરિવર્તનની જરૂરિયાત પર ભાર મૂક્યો.
items.why: 世代交代 (generational turnover/changeover) is the fixed phrase; 新興 is an adjective for something newly established (a religion, a neighborhood) and doesn't pair with 世代.

items.q: 彼らは双子だが、性格は（a.対照 b.対称）的だ。
items.qr: Karera wa futago da ga, seikaku wa (a. taishou b. taishou) teki da.
items.en: They're twins, but their personalities are a study in contrast.
items.hi: वे जुड़वां हैं, पर उनके स्वभाव में ज़मीन-आसमान का फ़र्क़ है।
items.gu: તેઓ જોડિયા છે, પણ તેમના સ્વભાવમાં સાવ વિરોધાભાસ છે.
items.why: 対照的 describes two things being different/opposite (fits "contrasting personalities"); 対称 describes mirror-image symmetry (shapes, designs), not personality traits.

items.q: 人質（a.解放 b.開放）のニュースが伝えられた。
items.qr: Hitojichi (a. kaihou b. kaihou) no nyuusu ga tsutaerareta.
items.en: News of the hostage's release was reported.
items.hi: बंधक की रिहाई की ख़बर सामने आई।
items.gu: બંધકની મુક્તિના સમાચાર આવ્યા.

opts.en: opening (a place to the public — wrong word)

items.why: 人質を解放する is the fixed phrase for releasing a hostage; 開放 is for opening up a place or facility (a school, a border), not freeing a person from captivity.

items.q: 交通費は会社から（a.支給 b.支持）される。
items.qr: Koutsuuhi wa kaisha kara (a. shikyuu b. shiji) sareru.
items.en: Transportation costs are paid by the company.
items.hi: यातायात का ख़र्च कंपनी द्वारा दिया जाता है।
items.gu: મુસાફરીનો ખર્ચ કંપની દ્વારા ચૂકવવામાં આવે છે.
items.why: 支給 is for a company/organization paying out money or goods; 支持 is for supporting a person, party, or opinion, not for issuing an allowance.

items.q: 野外音楽会の開催を（a.企画 b.避難）する。
items.qr: Yagai ongakkai no kaisai o (a. kikaku b. hinan) suru.
items.en: Plan the holding of an outdoor concert.
items.hi: खुले मैदान में संगीत समारोह आयोजित करने की योजना बनाना।
items.gu: ખુલ્લા મેદાનમાં સંગીત કાર્યક્રમ યોજવાનું આયોજન કરવું.
items.why: 企画する is the verb for planning/organizing an event; 避難する means to evacuate to safety and has no connection to concert planning.

items.q: ハンドル（a.指示 b.操作）を誤って事故を起こす。
items.qr: Handoru (a. shiji b. sousa) o ayamatte jiko o okosu.
items.en: Cause an accident through a steering error.
items.hi: स्टीयरिंग चलाने में ग़लती से दुर्घटना हो जाना।
items.gu: સ્ટિયરિંગ ચલાવવામાં ભૂલથી અકસ્માત થવો.
items.why: ハンドル操作 (steering operation) is the set phrase for physically handling a wheel/control; 指示 refers to giving/receiving verbal instructions, not physically operating machinery.

items.q: 経済状況は（a.以前 b.依然）として厳しい。
items.qr: Keizai joukyou wa (a. izen b. izen) toshite kibishii.
items.en: The economic situation remains severe.
items.hi: आर्थिक स्थिति अब भी कठिन बनी हुई है।
items.gu: આર્થિક પરિસ્થિતિ હજુ પણ કપરી છે.
items.why: 依然として is the fixed adverbial phrase for "remaining unchanged"; 以前 simply means "before/formerly" as a point in time and can't take としてin this sense.

items.q: （a.形成 b.形勢）が逆転し、チームは優勝した。
items.qr: (a. Keisei b. Keisei) ga gyakuten shi, chiimu wa yuushou shita.
items.en: The situation reversed, and the team won the championship.
items.hi: परिस्थिति पलट गई, और टीम चैंपियन बनी।
items.gu: પરિસ્થિતિ પલટાઈ, અને ટીમ ચેમ્પિયન બની.

opts.en: the state of a competitive situation

items.why: 形勢逆転 (a reversal of the game situation) is the book's own listed compound; 形成 refers to the formation/development of something (like personality), which doesn't "reverse" in a match.

items.q: 台風のため、電車が一時（a.不通 b.非難）になった。
items.qr: Taifuu no tame, densha ga ichiji (a. futsuu b. hinan) ni natta.
items.en: Because of the typhoon, trains were temporarily suspended.
items.hi: तूफ़ान की वजह से, ट्रेनें कुछ समय के लिए बंद हो गईं।
items.gu: વાવાઝોડાને કારણે, ટ્રેનો થોડા સમય માટે બંધ થઈ ગઈ.
items.why: 電車が不通になる is the set phrase for train service being suspended; 非難 means to criticize/blame someone and has nothing to do with service disruptions.

items.q: 事件の（a.契機 b.核心）に迫る情報はなかった。
items.qr: Jiken no (a. keiki b. kakushin) ni semaru jouhou wa nakatta.
items.en: There was no information that got to the heart of the case.
items.hi: मामले की तह तक पहुँचने वाली कोई जानकारी नहीं थी।
items.gu: કેસના મૂળ સુધી પહોંચે તેવી કોઈ માહિતી ન હતી.
items.why: 核心に迫る is the fixed phrase for "getting to the heart of" a case; 契機 means an opportunity/trigger that starts something, unrelated to what a piece of information "reaches."

items.q: 新市長は（a.抱負 b.負債）を述べた。
items.qr: Shin-shichou wa (a. houfu b. fusai) o nobeta.
items.en: The new mayor stated his aspirations.
items.hi: नए महापौर ने अपनी महत्वाकांक्षाएं बताईं।
items.gu: નવા મેયરે પોતાની મહત્વાકાંક્ષાઓ જણાવી.
items.why: 抱負を述べる is the set phrase for stating one's aspirations/resolutions; 負債 (debt) is a financial term with no place in an inaugural speech about hopes.

items.q: 転倒した選手は（a.閉口 b.棄権）せず、最後まで滑りきった。
items.qr: Tentou shita senshu wa (a. heikou b. kiken) sezu, saigo made suberikitta.
items.en: The skater who fell didn't withdraw, and skated to the very end.
items.hi: गिरने वाली/वाला खिलाड़ी ने हार नहीं मानी और आख़िर तक स्केटिंग पूरी की।
items.gu: પડી ગયેલા ખેલાડીએ ખસી જવાને બદલે અંત સુધી સ્કેટિંગ પૂરું કર્યું.
items.why: 棄権する is the verb for withdrawing from a competition; 閉口する describes being at a loss/annoyed by something (like a rude question), unrelated to competing.

items.q: 製品に（a.危険 b.欠陥）が見つかった。
items.qr: Seihin ni (a. kiken b. kekkan) ga mitsukatta.
items.en: A defect was found in the product.
items.hi: उत्पाद में एक ख़राबी पाई गई।
items.gu: ઉત્પાદનમાં ખામી મળી આવી.
items.why: 欠陥が見つかる is the set phrase for "a defect is found" (in a product); 危険 describes a state of danger, not a discoverable flaw itself.

items.q: 今回の最優秀賞には（a.該当 b.確信）者がなかった。
items.qr: Konkai no saiyuushuushou ni wa (a. gaitou b. kakushin) sha ga nakatta.
items.en: There was no eligible recipient for this round's top award.
items.hi: इस बार के सर्वश्रेष्ठ पुरस्कार के लिए कोई पात्र व्यक्ति नहीं मिला।
items.gu: આ વખતના શ્રેષ્ઠ પુરસ્કાર માટે કોઈ પાત્ર વ્યક્તિ ન મળી.
items.why: 該当者 (an eligible/qualifying person) is the fixed term for someone meeting award criteria; 確信 means personal conviction and doesn't describe eligibility.

items.q: 田中夫妻は社交的で、話題が（a.豊富 b.共作）だ。
items.qr: Tanaka fusai wa shakouteki de, wadai ga (a. houfu b. kyousaku) da.
items.en: The Tanakas are sociable, with a wealth of topics to talk about.
items.hi: तनाका दंपति मिलनसार हैं और उनके पास बातचीत के लिए ढेरों विषय हैं।
items.gu: તનાકા દંપતી મિલનસાર છે અને તેમની પાસે વાત કરવા માટે પુષ્કળ વિષયો છે.
items.why: 話題が豊富 (an abundance of topics) is the set phrase for a sociable, talkative person; 共作 refers to a jointly-created work (a song, a book), not a store of conversation topics.

items.q: 炭には脱臭、つまり臭いをとる効果がある。
items.qr: Sumi ni wa dasshuu, tsumari nioi o toru kouka ga aru.
items.en: Charcoal has a deodorizing effect — that is, it removes odors.
items.hi: कोयले में गंध सोखने का असर होता है, यानी वह बदबू दूर करता है।
items.gu: કોલસામાં ગંધ દૂર કરવાની અસર હોય છે, એટલે કે તે વાસ દૂર કરે છે.
items.why: Day 1's すみ group — 炭 (charcoal) shares the kun-yomi すみ with 墨 (ink) and 隅 (corner).

items.q: 候補者たちが街頭で演説をしている。
items.qr: Kouhosha-tachi ga gaitou de enzetsu o shite iru.
items.en: The candidates are giving speeches on the street.
items.hi: उम्मीदवार सड़क पर भाषण दे रहे हैं।
items.gu: ઉમેદવારો શેરીમાં ભાષણ આપી રહ્યા છે.
items.why: Day 6's がいとう group — 街頭 (a street/public place) shares this reading with 該当 (eligible).

items.q: 情報技術革新により、為替取引はオンライン、リアルタイムで可能だ。
items.qr: Jouhou gijutsu kakushin ni yori, kawase torihiki wa onrain, riarutaimu de kanou da.
items.en: Thanks to innovation in information technology, currency trading is now possible online, in real time.
items.hi: सूचना तकनीक में नवाचार की वजह से, मुद्रा व्यापार अब ऑनलाइन और रियल-टाइम में संभव है।
items.gu: માહિતી ટેકનોલોજીના નવીનીકરણને કારણે, ચલણ વેપાર હવે ઓનલાઇન અને રીઅલ-ટાઇમમાં શક્ય છે.
items.why: Day 6's かくしん group — 革新 (innovation) shares this reading with 核心 (the core) and 確信 (conviction).

items.q: この書類を至急届けてください。
items.qr: Kono shorui o shikyuu todokete kudasai.
items.en: Please deliver this document urgently.
items.hi: कृपया यह दस्तावेज़ तुरंत पहुँचाएं।
items.gu: કૃપા કરી આ દસ્તાવેજ તાત્કાલિક પહોંચાડો.
items.why: Day 5's しきゅう group — 至急 (urgent) shares this reading with 支給 (to pay out).

items.q: 年配の方には敬意を払うべきだ。
items.qr: Nenpai no kata ni wa keii o harau beki da.
items.en: One should show respect to one's elders.
items.hi: बड़ों का सम्मान करना चाहिए।
items.gu: વડીલોનું સન્માન કરવું જોઈએ.
items.why: Day 5's けいい group — 敬意 (respect) shares this reading with 経緯 (circumstances).

items.q: 公害訴訟は和解が成立した。
items.qr: Kougai soshou wa wakai ga seiritsu shita.
items.en: A settlement was reached in the pollution lawsuit.
items.hi: प्रदूषण संबंधी मुक़दमे में समझौता हो गया।
items.gu: પ્રદૂષણ અંગેના દાવામાં સમાધાન થયું.
items.why: Day 5's こうがい group — 公害 (pollution) shares this reading with 郊外 (the suburbs).

items.q: 規格外野菜を安く購入する。
items.qr: Kikakugai yasai o yasuku kounyuu suru.
items.en: Buy off-standard (irregularly-shaped) vegetables cheaply.
items.hi: मानक से बाहर की सब्ज़ियाँ सस्ते में ख़रीदना।
items.gu: ધારાધોરણ બહારના શાકભાજી સસ્તા ભાવે ખરીદવા.
items.why: Day 5's きかく group — 規格 (a standard/spec) shares this reading with 企画 (planning).

items.q: ある国ではひどい凶作により、農民が集団自殺を図った。
items.qr: Aru kuni de wa hidoi kyousaku ni yori, noumin ga shuudan jisatsu o hakatta.
items.en: In one country, a severe crop failure led farmers to attempt mass suicide.
items.hi: एक देश में भयंकर फ़सल बर्बादी के कारण, किसानों ने सामूहिक आत्महत्या का प्रयास किया।
items.gu: એક દેશમાં ભયંકર પાક નિષ્ફળતાને કારણે, ખેડૂતોએ સામૂહિક આત્મહત્યાનો પ્રયાસ કર્યો.
items.why: Day 6's きょうさく group — 凶作 (a poor harvest) shares this reading with 共作 (a joint work).

items.q: 筋肉や血管に注射をする。
items.qr: Kinniku ya kekkan ni chuusha o suru.
items.en: Give an injection into muscle or a blood vessel.
items.hi: मांसपेशी या नस में इंजेक्शन लगाना।
items.gu: સ્નાયુ કે નસમાં ઈન્જેક્શન આપવું.
items.why: Day 6's own title pair — 注射 (an injection) shares ちゅうしゃ with 駐車 (parking).

items.q: 貴社のますますの発展をお祈り申し上げます。
items.qr: Kisha no masumasu no hatten o oinori moushiagemasu.
items.en: We wish your company continued growth and success.
items.hi: हम आपकी कंपनी की निरंतर उन्नति की कामना करते हैं।
items.gu: અમે તમારી કંપનીની સતત પ્રગતિની કામના કરીએ છીએ.
items.why: Day 6's きしゃ group — 貴社 (the honorific "your company," used in letters) shares this reading with 記者 (a reporter) and 汽車 (a steam train).

items.q: りんごのかわをむく。
items.qr: Ringo no kawa o muku.
items.en: Peel an apple.
items.hi: सेब का छिलका उतारना।
items.gu: સફરજનની છાલ ઉતારવી.
items.why: Day 1's かわ group — 皮 is the kanji for a natural peel/skin (fruit, animal), distinct from 革 (tanned leather).

items.q: 言葉では言いあらわせない。
items.qr: Kotoba de wa ii-arawasenai.
items.en: It cannot be expressed in words.
items.hi: इसे शब्दों में बयान नहीं किया जा सकता।
items.gu: તેને શબ્દોમાં વ્યક્ત ન કરી શકાય.
items.why: Day 1's あらわす group — 言葉に表す ("put into words") uses 表す; 現す is for appearing/unmasking, not expressing in language.

items.q: 問題の解決につとめる。
items.qr: Mondai no kaiketsu ni tsutomeru.
items.en: Strive to resolve the problem.
items.hi: समस्या सुलझाने का प्रयास करना।
items.gu: સમસ્યા ઉકેલવાનો પ્રયત્ન કરવો.
items.why: Day 2's つとめる group — 問題の解決に努める (striving to solve a problem) is the book's own listed phrase for 努める.

items.q: 受付はしめきりました。
items.qr: Uketsuke wa shimekirimashita.
items.en: Reception has closed (the deadline has passed).
items.hi: पंजीकरण की अंतिम तिथि निकल चुकी है।
items.gu: નોંધણીની અંતિમ તારીખ પૂરી થઈ ગઈ છે.
items.why: Day 3's しめる group lists 締め切る specifically as "to close by a deadline"; 閉める is for physically closing doors/lids, 絞める is to strangle, 占める is to occupy a share.

items.q: 合格するまでチョコレートをたちます。
items.qr: Goukaku suru made chokoreeto o tachimasu.
items.en: I will give up chocolate until I pass.
items.hi: पास होने तक चॉकलेट छोड़ दूँगा/दूँगी।
items.gu: પાસ થાઉં ત્યાં સુધી ચોકલેટ છોડી દઈશ.
items.why: Day 3's たつ group lists both 酒を断つ (voluntarily giving up a habit/vice) and 食事を絶つ／断つ (fasting) — reasoned here as 断つ, since giving up an indulgence like chocolate as an act of willpower parallels 酒を断つ more closely than 絶つ's harsher "sever completely" sense (as in 命を絶つ). Flagged as the one genuinely ambiguous answer this week — the book's own entries show overlap between 絶つ and 断つ for "fasting/quitti

items.q: この子は左（ ）です。
items.qr: Kono ko wa hidari (___) desu.
items.en: This child is left-handed.
items.hi: यह बच्चा बाएं हाथ से काम करता/करती है।
items.gu: આ બાળક ડાબોડી છે.
items.why: Day 1's きく group — 左利き (left-handed) uses 利き, from 利く ("to be sharp/dexterous").

items.q: （ ）海公園に遊びに行く。
items.qr: (___) kai kouen ni asobi ni iku.
items.en: Go to the seaside park to play.
items.hi: समुद्र किनारे के पार्क में घूमने जाना।
items.gu: દરિયાકિનારાના પાર્કમાં ફરવા જવું.
items.why: Day 3's のぞむ group — 臨海公園 ("a seaside/waterfront park") uses 臨, from 海を臨む ("face the sea").

items.q: 船が（ ）波に沈んだ。
items.qr: Fune ga (___) nami ni shizunda.
items.en: The ship sank in rough waves.
items.hi: जहाज़ तूफ़ानी लहरों में डूब गया।
items.gu: વહાણ તોફાની મોજાંમાં ડૂબી ગયું.
items.why: Day 1's あらい group — 荒波 (rough/violent waves) uses 荒, describing turbulent nature; 粗い is for coarse texture/mesh, not sea conditions.

items.q: 何かとてもいいことがあったのか、妻は（ ）機嫌だ。
items.qr: Nanika totemo ii koto ga atta no ka, tsuma wa (___) kigen da.
items.en: Something must have gone very well — my wife is in a great mood.
items.hi: शायद कुछ बहुत अच्छा हुआ है, मेरी पत्नी बहुत अच्छे मूड में है।
items.gu: કદાચ કંઈક ખૂબ સારું થયું છે, મારી પત્ની ખૂબ સારા મૂડમાં છે.
items.why: Day 4's きげん group — 上機嫌 ("in a great mood") uses 上; 不機嫌 (bad mood) is the opposite, and 最/高 don't form standard collocations here.

items.q: 大学時代を（ ）意義に過ごす。
items.qr: Daigaku jidai o (___) igi ni sugosu.
items.en: Spend one's university years meaningfully.
items.hi: विश्वविद्यालय के दिनों को सार्थक ढंग से बिताना।
items.gu: યુનિવર્સિટીના દિવસો અર્થપૂર્ણ રીતે વિતાવવા.
items.why: Day 5's いぎ group — 有意義に ("meaningfully") uses 有, from 有意義な; the other options don't form real words with 意義 here.

items.q: 国民に隠されていた事実が（ ）になった。
items.qr: Kokumin ni kakusarete ita jijitsu ga (___) ni natta.
items.en: The fact that had been hidden from the public came to light.
items.hi: जनता से छिपाया गया तथ्य सार्वजनिक हो गया।
items.gu: જનતાથી છુપાવેલી હકીકત જાહેર થઈ ગઈ.
items.why: 公になる is the fixed idiom for a hidden fact "becoming public"; 穴 (a hole) has no such idiomatic use with になる in this sense.

items.q: 家族の笑顔が私の元気の（ ）です。
items.qr: Kazoku no egao ga watashi no genki no (___) desu.
items.en: My family's smiles are the source of my energy.
items.hi: मेरे परिवार की मुस्कान मेरी ऊर्जा का स्रोत है।
items.gu: મારા પરિવારનું સ્મિત મારી ઊર્જાનો સ્રોત છે.
items.why: 元気の源 "a source of energy" is a fixed phrase in this list; 塊 "a lump" describes a physical mass, not an abstract origin of energy.

items.q: 漢字の読み方を間違えて（ ）をかきました。
items.qr: Kanji no yomikata o machigaete (___) o kakimashita.
items.en: I embarrassed myself by misreading the kanji.
items.hi: कांजी की गलत रीडिंग करके मैं शर्मिंदा हो गया/गई।
items.gu: કાંજીનું ખોટું વાંચન કરીને હું શરમાયો/શરમાઈ.
items.why: 恥をかく is the set phrase "to embarrass oneself"; 罪 refers to guilt/wrongdoing, which doesn't fit a simple reading mistake.

items.q: 悔しくて（ ）を噛んだ。
items.qr: Kuyashikute (___) o kanda.
items.en: I bit my lip in frustration.
items.hi: मलाल/निराशा में मैंने अपना होंठ काट लिया।
items.gu: નિરાશામાં મેં મારો હોઠ કરડ્યો.
items.why: 唇を噛む "bite one's lip" is the idiom for frustration/regret; 舌を噛む "bite one's tongue" describes an accidental slip of the tongue, not an emotional reaction.

items.q: 幼い子の立派な行動に大人は（ ）を正した。
items.qr: Osanai ko no rippa na koudou ni otona wa (___) o tadashita.
items.en: The adults straightened up in response to the young child's admirable behavior.
items.hi: छोटे बच्चे के प्रशंसनीय व्यवहार को देखकर बड़े लोग सतर्क/शालीन हो गए।
items.gu: નાના બાળકના પ્રશંસનીય વર્તનથી મોટેરાં સાવધ થઈ ગયાં.
items.why: 襟を正す "straighten one's collar" is the fixed idiom for becoming respectful/serious; 丈 only means physical length (of a coat), it has no such idiomatic use.

items.q: この酒は、なかなか手に入らないので（ ）の酒と呼ばれている。
items.qr: Kono sake wa, nakanaka te ni hairanai node (___) no sake to yobarete iru.
items.en: This sake is hard to get, so it's called a "phantom" (extremely rare) sake.
items.hi: यह साके आसानी से नहीं मिलती, इसलिए इसे "दुर्लभ/मायावी" साके कहा जाता है।
items.gu: આ સાકે સહેલાઈથી મળતું નથી, એટલે તેને "દુર્લભ" સાકે કહેવાય છે.
items.why: 幻の酒 "phantom sake" is the set phrase for something so rare it is almost mythical; 紫 is simply a color and doesn't collocate with rarity.

items.q: 育児休暇を終えて、仕事に（ ）する。
items.qr: Ikuji kyuuka o oete, shigoto ni (___) suru.
items.en: After finishing childcare leave, she returns to work.
items.hi: बाल-देखभाल अवकाश खत्म करके, वह काम पर वापस लौटती है।
items.gu: બાળ-સંભાળ રજા પૂરી કરીને, તે કામ પર પરત ફરે છે.
items.why: 仕事に復帰する is the fixed collocation for a person returning to their job; 復活 describes an event or custom being revived, not a person's own return.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 2 · 返済・返却・返還

items.q: （ ）の用紙に必要事項を記入してください。
items.qr: (___) no youshi ni hitsuyou jikou o kinyuu shite kudasai.
items.en: Please fill in the required information on the prescribed form.
items.hi: कृपया निर्धारित फ़ॉर्म पर आवश्यक जानकारी भरें।
items.gu: કૃપા કરી નિર્ધારિત ફોર્મમાં જરૂરી માહિતી ભરો.

opts.en: a regulation (pairs with fees/rules, not forms)

items.why: 所定の用紙 "the prescribed form" is the set phrase for an officially designated document; 規定 collocates with fees/rules (規定の料金), not with a physical form.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 2 · 返済・返却・返還

items.q: ネクタイやスーツは（ ）だ。もっと気楽な服装で出勤したい。
items.qr: Nekutai ya suutsu wa (___) da. Motto kiraku na fukusou de shukkin shitai.
items.en: Ties and suits are cramped/restrictive. I want to commute in more relaxed clothes.
items.hi: टाई और सूट तंग/असहज लगते हैं। मैं ज़्यादा आरामदायक कपड़ों में दफ़्तर जाना चाहता/चाहती हूँ।
items.gu: ટાઈ અને સૂટ સાંકડાં/અસહજ લાગે છે. હું વધુ આરામદાયક કપડાંમાં ઑફિસ જવા માંગું છું.
items.why: 窮屈 describes something physically confining or restrictive, which fits stiff formal clothing; 退屈 means "boring" and applies to time or activities, not garments.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 2 · 返済・返却・返還

items.q: 被災地の（ ）支援をする。
items.qr: Hisaichi no (___) shien o suru.
items.en: We provide reconstruction support for the disaster-hit area.
items.hi: आपदा-ग्रस्त क्षेत्र के पुनर्निर्माण में सहायता करना।
items.gu: આપત્તિગ્રસ્ત વિસ્તારના પુનર્નિર્માણમાં સહાય કરવી.
items.why: 復興 is used for rebuilding a country, region, or economy after a disaster; 回復 is reserved for smaller-scale recovery like health or weather.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 2 · 返済・返却・返還

items.q: 彼は職務（ ）で減給になった。
items.qr: Kare wa shokumu (___) de genkyuu ni natta.
items.en: He had his pay cut for neglecting his duties.
items.hi: कर्तव्य में लापरवाही के कारण उसका वेतन घटा दिया गया।
items.gu: ફરજમાં બેદરકારીના કારણે તેનો પગાર ઘટાડવામાં આવ્યો.

opts.en: slow (describes motion, not a punishable fault)

items.why: 職務怠慢 "dereliction of duty" is the fixed phrase for neglecting one's responsibilities (a punishable fault); 緩慢 only describes slow physical movement.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 2 · 返済・返却・返還

items.q: 腰痛がひどくなり、日常生活に（ ）を来すようになった。
items.qr: Youtsuu ga hidoku nari, nichijou seikatsu ni (___) o kitasu you ni natta.
items.en: The back pain worsened until it began interfering with daily life.
items.hi: कमर दर्द इतना बढ़ गया कि रोज़मर्रा की ज़िंदगी में रुकावट आने लगी।
items.gu: કમરનો દુખાવો એટલો વધ્યો કે રોજિંદા જીવનમાં અડચણ આવવા લાગી.

opts.en: a technical fault (wrong scope for a person's life)

items.why: 支障を来す "cause hindrance" is the fixed phrase for something interfering with one's own life/work; 障害 more commonly describes a technical fault (signal, server) or a disability.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 2 · 返済・返却・返還

items.q: 人身事故のためダイヤが乱れています。予めご（ ）ください。
items.qr: Jinshin jiko no tame daiya ga midarete imasu. Arakajime go-(___) kudasai.
items.en: Train schedules are disrupted due to a person-involved accident. Please understand this in advance.
items.hi: दुर्घटना के कारण ट्रेन का समय-चक्र बिगड़ा हुआ है। कृपया पहले से इसे स्वीकार करें।
items.gu: અકસ્માતના કારણે ટ્રેનનું સમયપત્રક ખોરવાયું છે. કૃપા કરી અગાઉથી સ્વીકારો.

opts.en: consent (to a request — wrong register for an announcement)

items.why: ご了承ください is the fixed polite phrase for asking the public to accept an inconvenience in advance; 承諾 is for consenting to a specific request/demand between two parties, not a public announcement.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 3 · 分解・分析・分類・分配

items.q: 時計を（ ）して掃除する。
items.qr: Tokei o (___) shite souji suru.
items.en: Take apart the clock to clean it.
items.hi: घड़ी के पुर्जे अलग करके उसे साफ़ करना।
items.gu: ઘડિયાળના ભાગ છૂટા પાડીને સાફ કરવું.
items.why: 分解 is taking a physical object like a clock or machine apart; 分析 is examining data or results, not disassembling hardware.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 3 · 分解・分析・分類・分配

items.q: 有害サイトの（ ）ができないように携帯電話を設定する。
items.qr: Yuugai saito no (___) ga dekinai you ni keitai denwa o settei suru.
items.en: Set up the phone so harmful websites cannot be browsed.
items.hi: हानिकारक वेबसाइटें न देखी जा सकें, इसके लिए फ़ोन सेट करना।
items.gu: હાનિકારક વેબસાઇટ ન જોઈ શકાય તે માટે ફોન સેટ કરવો.
items.why: 閲覧 is the standard word for browsing/reading a website or document; 展覧 refers to a physical exhibition (of art, etc.), not viewing a webpage.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 3 · 分解・分析・分類・分配

items.q: 漁船が（ ）し、乗組員全員が行方不明となった。
items.qr: Gyosen ga (___) shi, norikumiin zen'in ga yukue fumei to natta.
items.en: The fishing boat sank, and the entire crew went missing.
items.hi: मछली पकड़ने वाली नाव डूब गई और पूरा दल लापता हो गया।
items.gu: માછીમારીની હોડી ડૂબી ગઈ અને આખો ક્રૂ ગુમ થઈ ગયો.
items.why: 沈没 specifically describes a boat/ship sinking in water; 没落 describes a family or fortune falling into decline over time, not a physical sinking.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 3 · 分解・分析・分類・分配

items.q: 仕事のために（ ）を利用する。
items.qr: Shigoto no tame ni (___) o riyou suru.
items.en: Use one's network of contacts for work.
items.hi: काम के लिए अपने संपर्कों का इस्तेमाल करना।
items.gu: કામ માટે પોતાના સંપર્કોનો ઉપયોગ કરવો.
items.why: 人脈 refers to a person's network of social/professional connections; 文脈 refers only to the context surrounding a piece of text.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 3 · 分解・分析・分類・分配

items.q: A社はB社との提携について（ ）を進めている。
items.qr: Ei-sha wa Bii-sha to no teikei ni tsuite (___) o susumete iru.
items.en: Company A is proceeding with negotiations over a partnership with Company B.
items.hi: कंपनी A, कंपनी B के साथ साझेदारी को लेकर बातचीत आगे बढ़ा रही है।
items.gu: કંપની A, કંપની B સાથે ભાગીદારી અંગે વાટાઘાટ આગળ વધારી રહી છે.
items.why: 交渉 is a formal, mutually agreed negotiation between two parties; 干渉 means unwanted interference in someone else's affairs, which doesn't fit a business partnership discussion.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 3 · 分解・分析・分類・分配

items.q: （ ）どの子どもにも愛情を注ぐ。
items.qr: (___) dono kodomo ni mo aijou o sosogu.
items.en: She pours affection on every child equally, without favoritism.
items.hi: वह बिना भेदभाव के हर बच्चे पर स्नेह लुटाती है।
items.gu: તે ભેદભાવ વગર દરેક બાળક પર સ્નેહ વરસાવે છે.
items.why: 分け隔てなく means "without discrimination between people," which fits loving every child equally; 懲りない means "not learning a lesson from a bad experience," an unrelated idea.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 4 · 融通が利く・便宜を図る

items.q: 論文を書き続けている先輩の（ ）見舞いに行った。
items.qr: Ronbun o kakitsuzukete iru senpai no (___) mimai ni itta.
items.en: I went to cheer on my senior who has been writing their thesis nonstop.
items.hi: मैं अपने सीनियर से मिलने गया, जो लगातार अपना शोध-प्रबंध लिख रहे हैं।
items.gu: હું મારા સિનિયરને મળવા ગયો, જે સતત પોતાનો શોધનિબંધ લખી રહ્યા છે.

opts.en: a visit to cheer on someone hard at work
(only used in 謹賀新年, New Year greeting)

items.why: 陣中見舞い is specifically a visit to encourage someone who is deep in demanding work; 謹賀 only ever appears inside the New Year's greeting 謹賀新年, unrelated to visiting someone.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 4 · 融通が利く・便宜を図る

items.q: 大臣は時代（ ）な発言をした。
items.qr: Daijin wa jidai (___) na hatsugen o shita.
items.en: The minister made an anachronistic (out-of-touch) remark.
items.hi: मंत्री ने पुराने ख़यालों वाली/समय से पीछे की टिप्पणी की।
items.gu: મંત્રીએ જૂનવાણી નિવેદન કર્યું.

opts.en: an illusion (only pairs with 目の, not 時代)

items.why: 時代錯誤 "anachronism" is the fixed compound for being out of step with the times; 錯覚 only combines with 目の (an optical illusion), not 時代.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 4 · 融通が利く・便宜を図る

items.q: 妹は感情の（ ）が激しい。
items.qr: Imouto wa kanjou no (___) ga hageshii.
items.en: My younger sister has intense emotional ups and downs.
items.hi: मेरी छोटी बहन की भावनाओं में बहुत तेज़ उतार-चढ़ाव होता है।
items.gu: મારી નાની બહેનની લાગણીઓમાં ખૂબ તીવ્ર ચઢાવ-ઉતાર આવે છે.
items.why: 感情の起伏 "emotional ups and downs" is the fixed phrase for mood swings; 妥協 "compromise" describes negotiation between people, unrelated to one's own emotions.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 4 · 融通が利く・便宜を図る

items.q: （ ）書類に目を通す。
items.qr: (___) shorui ni me o toosu.
items.en: Look over the attached documents.
items.hi: संलग्न दस्तावेज़ों पर नज़र डालना।
items.gu: જોડાયેલા દસ્તાવેજો પર નજર નાખવી.
items.why: 添付書類 "attached documents" only makes sense with email/files; 扶養 describes financially supporting a family member, not a document.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 4 · 融通が利く・便宜を図る

items.q: 母はめったに（ ）をこぼさない。
items.qr: Haha wa mettani (___) o kobosanai.
items.en: My mother rarely complains.
items.hi: मेरी माँ शायद ही कभी शिकायत करती हैं।
items.gu: મારી માતા ભાગ્યે જ ફરિયાદ કરે છે.
items.why: 愚痴をこぼす "voice a complaint" is a fixed idiom (literally "spill out a grumble"); 炊事 "cooking/housework" is just a noun with no idiomatic link to こぼす.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 4 · 融通が利く・便宜を図る

items.q: 「た」はにごっていない音、つまり（ ）です。
items.qr: "Ta" wa nigotte inai oto, tsumari (___) desu.
items.en: "Ta" is an unvoiced sound — in other words, a 清音.
items.hi: "ता" एक बिना-घोष (अनवॉइस्ड) ध्वनि है, यानी 清音 है।
items.gu: "તા" એ અઘોષ (અનવોઇસ્ડ) ધ્વનિ છે, એટલે કે 清音 છે.
items.why: The sentence describes a sound that is "not voiced" (にごっていない) — that is precisely the definition of 清音; 濁音 is the voiced counterpart, the opposite of what's described.

items.q: （ ）なのはいいことだが、たまには大胆になってみてはどうか。
items.qr: (___) na no wa ii koto da ga, tama ni wa daitan ni natte mite wa dou ka.
items.en: Being careful is good, but why not try being bold once in a while?
items.hi: सतर्क रहना अच्छी बात है, लेकिन कभी-कभी निडर बनकर भी देखो न?
items.gu: સાવધ રહેવું સારી વાત છે, પણ ક્યારેક નિડર બનીને પણ જુઓ ને?

opts.en: precious, valuable (not the antonym of 大胆)

items.why: The sentence sets up a contrast with 大胆 "bold" — its true antonym in this list is 慎重 "careful"; 貴重 "precious" is an unrelated word that merely sounds similar.

items.q: この道路は（ ）的に渋滞している。
items.qr: Kono douro wa (___) teki ni juutai shite iru.
items.en: This road is chronically congested.
items.hi: यह सड़क लगातार/पुराने ढंग से जाम रहती है।
items.gu: આ રસ્તો સતત ટ્રાફિકજામ રહે છે.

opts.en: leisurely (describes a manner, not a recurring state)

items.why: 慢性的に "chronically" describes a persistent, recurring state like traffic congestion; 悠長 describes an unhurried manner or pace, not a state that keeps recurring — a cross-family trap since both can sound plausible before 的に.

items.q: 先頭を走るランナーとの距離を（ ）追いついた。
items.qr: Sentou o hashiru rannaa to no kyori o (___) oitsuita.
items.en: Closing the gap with the lead runner, he caught up.
items.hi: आगे दौड़ रहे धावक से दूरी कम करते हुए वह उसके बराबर आ गया।
items.gu: આગળ દોડતા દોડવીર સાથેનું અંતર ઘટાડીને તે તેની બરાબર આવી ગયો.
items.why: Catching up means shrinking the gap, so 縮める "shorten" is correct; 伸ばす "lengthen/stretch" would mean widening the gap, the opposite of catching up.

items.q: 信念は頑固に曲げないが、表現の仕方には（ ）さがある。
items.qr: Shinnen wa ganko ni magenai ga, hyougen no shikata ni wa (___) sa ga aru.
items.en: He won't bend his convictions, but there's flexibility in how he expresses them.
items.hi: वह अपने सिद्धांतों में हठी है, पर उन्हें व्यक्त करने के तरीक़े में लचीलापन रखता है।
items.gu: તે પોતાના સિદ્ધાંતોમાં હઠીલો છે, પણ તેને વ્યક્ત કરવાની રીતમાં લવચીકતા ધરાવે છે.
items.why: The sentence contrasts 頑固 "stubborn" with its true antonym 柔軟 "flexible"; 膨張 describes physical/numeric expansion, unrelated to personal attitude.

items.q: いつもの食事は質素だが、家族の誕生日には（ ）な料理を作る。
items.qr: Itsumo no shokuji wa shisso da ga, kazoku no tanjoubi ni wa (___) na ryouri o tsukuru.
items.en: Everyday meals are simple, but on a family birthday, I make a lavish spread.
items.hi: रोज़ का खाना सादा होता है, पर परिवार के जन्मदिन पर मैं शानदार खाना बनाती/बनाता हूँ।
items.gu: રોજનું ભોજન સાદું હોય છે, પણ પરિવારના જન્મદિવસે હું ભવ્ય ભોજન બનાવું છું.
items.why: The sentence contrasts everyday 質素 "frugal" meals with its antonym 豪華 "lavish" for a birthday; 勇敢 "brave" describes courage, unrelated to food.

items.q: （ ）を繰り返して、ついに成功した。
items.qr: (___) o kurikaeshite, tsui ni seikou shita.
items.en: After repeated trial and error, I finally succeeded.
items.hi: बार-बार आज़माइश और ग़लती करते हुए, आख़िरकार मुझे सफलता मिली।
items.gu: વારંવાર અજમાયશ અને ભૂલ કરીને, છેવટે મને સફળતા મળી.

opts.en: alternating joy and worry (no link to eventual success)

items.why: 試行錯誤 describes a repeated process of attempting and failing that eventually leads to success; 一喜一憂 describes being emotionally swayed by each individual outcome, not a path toward success.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 6 · 単刀直入・一言一句

items.q: マニュアル通りではなく、（ ）に対応してほしい。
items.qr: Manyuaru doori de wa naku, (___) ni taiou shite hoshii.
items.en: I want you to respond flexibly to the situation, not just follow the manual.
items.hi: मैनुअल के अनुसार नहीं, बल्कि परिस्थिति के अनुसार प्रतिक्रिया दो।
items.gu: મેન્યુઅલ પ્રમાણે નહીં, પણ સંજોગો પ્રમાણે પ્રતિભાવ આપો.
items.why: 臨機応変 describes adapting one's approach to fit the situation, which is what's being requested; 支離滅裂 describes incoherent, disorganized behavior — the opposite of a positive quality to request.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 6 · 単刀直入・一言一句

items.q: 男は会社を首になり、（ ）になって犯行に及んだという。
items.qr: Otoko wa kaisha o kubi ni nari, (___) ni natte hankou ni oyonda to iu.
items.en: It's said the man was fired and, falling into desperation, committed the crime.
items.hi: कहा जाता है कि उस आदमी को नौकरी से निकाला गया और हताश होकर उसने अपराध किया।
items.gu: કહેવાય છે કે તે માણસને નોકરીમાંથી કાઢી મુકાયો અને નિરાશ થઈને તેણે ગુનો કર્યો.

opts.en: groping in the dark for a solution (not a state that leads to crime)

items.why: 自暴自棄 describes giving up on oneself and acting recklessly/destructively, matching a fired man turning to crime; 暗中模索 describes searching for a solution blindly, not a state of reckless despair.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 6 · 単刀直入・一言一句

items.q: 美辞麗句を並べないで、（ ）に言ってくれませんか。
items.qr: Bijireiku o narabenaide, (___) ni itte kuremasen ka.
items.en: Could you just tell me straightforwardly, without flowery language?
items.hi: शब्दाडंबर के बिना, कृपया सीधे शब्दों में बताएँ?
items.gu: શબ્દાડંબર વગર, કૃપા કરી સીધેસીધું કહેશો?

opts.en: rounding up all at once (unrelated to speaking style)

items.why: 単刀直入 is the direct opposite of using flowery language — speaking plainly and to the point; 一網打尽 describes catching everything at once, unrelated to speaking manner.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 6 · 単刀直入・一言一句

items.q: 唯一無二の親友が受賞して、私も（ ）です。
items.qr: Yuiitsu muni no shin'yuu ga jushou shite, watashi mo (___) desu.
items.en: My one-and-only best friend won an award, and I too am overcome with emotion.
items.hi: मेरे बेजोड़ दोस्त को पुरस्कार मिला, और मैं भी बेहद भावुक हूँ।
items.gu: મારા અજોડ મિત્રને પુરસ્કાર મળ્યો, અને હું પણ ખૂબ ભાવુક છું.
items.why: 感慨無量 describes being overwhelmed with emotion at a meaningful moment, matching a friend's award; 新陳代謝 is a purely biological term for metabolism, unrelated to feelings.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 6 · 単刀直入・一言一句

items.q: （ ）するばかりで、役に立たない手伝いなら不要だ。
items.qr: (___) suru bakari de, yaku ni tatanai tetsudai nara fuyou da.
items.en: If all the "help" does is scramble about in confusion and achieve nothing, it's not needed.
items.hi: अगर मदद सिर्फ़ इधर-उधर भागदौड़ करना है और किसी काम की नहीं, तो उसकी ज़रूरत नहीं।
items.gu: જો મદદ ફક્ત આમતેમ દોડાદોડ કરવાની જ હોય અને કંઈ કામની ન હોય, તો તેની જરૂર નથી.
items.why: 右往左往 describes running about uselessly without direction, matching "help that's not helpful"; 創意工夫 is a positive trait (ingenuity), which would contradict calling the help useless.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 6 · 単刀直入・一言一句

items.q: この辺りは趣のある店が並んでいる。
items.qr: Kono atari wa omomuki no aru mise ga narande iru.
items.en: This area is lined with shops that have real character.
items.hi: इस इलाक़े में रुचिपूर्ण दुकानें हैं।
items.gu: આ વિસ્તારમાં રુચિપૂર્ણ દુકાનો છે.
items.why: Day 1's 概念 group — 趣のある庭 "a tasteful garden" uses the same reading おもむき.

items.q: 選手たちは技を磨いて試合に臨んだ。
items.qr: Senshu-tachi wa waza o migaite shiai ni nozonda.
items.en: The athletes honed their skills and faced the match.
items.hi: खिलाड़ियों ने अपना हुनर निखारकर मैच का सामना किया।
items.gu: ખેલાડીઓએ પોતાનું કૌશલ્ય નિખારીને મેચનો સામનો કર્યો.
items.why: Day 1's 概念 group — 技を磨く "improve one's skill" reads 技 as わざ.

items.q: 手のひらの静脈で本人を認証するシステムがある。
items.qr: Te no hira no joumyaku de honnin o ninshou suru shisutemu ga aru.
items.en: There is a system that authenticates a person by the veins in their palm.
items.hi: हथेली की शिराओं से पहचान प्रमाणित करने वाला सिस्टम है।
items.gu: હથેળીની શિરાઓથી ઓળખ પ્રમાણિત કરતી સિસ્ટમ છે.

opts.en: (not a real reading of 静脈)

items.why: Day 3's 脈 family — 静脈 (⇔動脈) reads じょうみゃく, "a vein."

items.q: 志を果たして故郷に帰る。
items.qr: Kokorozashi o hatashite kokyou ni kaeru.
items.en: Having realized my aspiration, I return to my hometown.
items.hi: अपना संकल्प पूरा करके वतन लौटना।
items.gu: પોતાનો સંકલ્પ પૂરો કરીને વતન પાછા ફરવું.
items.why: Day 1's 概念 group — 志を果たす "realize one's aspirations" reads 志 as こころざし.

items.q: あの役人の行為は腹に据えかねる。
items.qr: Ano yakunin no koui wa hara ni suekaneru.
items.en: That official's conduct is infuriating beyond endurance.
items.hi: उस अफ़सर का व्यवहार बर्दाश्त से बाहर है, गुस्सा रोका नहीं जा रहा।
items.gu: તે અધિકારીનું વર્તન સહન ન થાય તેવું છે, ગુસ્સો કાબૂમાં નથી.

opts.en: set, place (as in 据えかねる)

items.why: Day 4's emotional-reactions group — 腹に据えかねる "unable to hold back one's anger" reads 据え as すえ.

items.q: 推薦入学で高校に入る。
items.qr: Suisen nyuugaku de koukou ni hairu.
items.en: Enter high school through recommendation-based admission.
items.hi: सिफ़ारिश के आधार पर हाई स्कूल में प्रवेश लेना।
items.gu: ભલામણના આધારે હાઈસ્કૂલમાં પ્રવેશ મેળવવો.
items.why: Day 2's 推 family — 推薦入学 "admission by recommendation" reads 推薦 as すいせん (推奨/すいしょう is the near-relative, but means endorsement of a solution/product, not admission).

items.q: 彼は炊事、洗濯、掃除、何でもできます。
items.qr: Kare wa suiji, sentaku, souji, nan demo dekimasu.
items.en: He can do cooking, laundry, cleaning — anything.
items.hi: वह खाना बनाना, कपड़े धोना, सफ़ाई करना — सब कुछ कर सकता है।
items.gu: તે રસોઈ, કપડાં ધોવા, સફાઈ — બધું જ કરી શકે છે.

opts.en: housework in general (close, but wrong reading of 炊事)

items.why: Day 4's everyday-sayings group — 炊事・洗濯 "cooking and laundry" reads 炊事 as すいじ.

items.q: 扶養家族がいると所得税が控除される。
items.qr: Fuyou kazoku ga iru to shotokuzei ga koujo sareru.
items.en: Having dependents earns an income-tax deduction.
items.hi: आश्रितों के होने पर आयकर में छूट मिलती है।
items.gu: આશ્રિતો હોય તો આવકવેરામાં કપાત મળે છે.
items.why: Day 4's work-and-social-life group — 扶養家族 "dependents" reads 扶養 as ふよう.

items.q: 私は大ざっぱですが、息子は几帳面です。
items.qr: Watashi wa oozappa desu ga, musuko wa kichoumen desu.
items.en: I'm sloppy, but my son is meticulous.
items.hi: मैं लापरवाह हूँ, पर मेरा बेटा बहुत सुव्यवस्थित है।
items.gu: હું બેદરકાર છું, પણ મારો દીકરો ખૂબ વ્યવસ્થિત છે.
items.why: Day 5's style-and-discipline pair — 几帳面 (⇔大ざっぱ) reads きちょうめん.

items.q: 悠長にしている暇はない。迅速に対応するように。
items.qr: Yuuchou ni shite iru hima wa nai. Jinsoku ni taiou suru you ni.
items.en: There's no time to be leisurely. Respond promptly.
items.hi: इत्मीनान से रहने का समय नहीं है। तुरंत प्रतिक्रिया दो।
items.gu: નિરાંતે રહેવાનો સમય નથી. તાત્કાલિક પ્રતિભાવ આપો.

opts.en: promptly (adverb, wrong reading of this word)

items.why: Day 5's pace-and-depth pair — 迅速 (⇔悠長) reads じんそく.

items.q: 不法とうきは罰せられます。
items.qr: Fuhou touki wa basserare masu.
items.en: Illegal dumping is punishable.
items.hi: अवैध कचरा फेंकना दंडनीय है।
items.gu: ગેરકાયદે કચરો ફેંકવો સજાપાત્ર છે.
items.why: Day 6's problem-solving group — 不法投棄 "illegal dumping" uses 投棄, not the homophones 陶器/登記/冬季.

items.q: ごらく施設の充実を図る。
items.qr: Goraku shisetsu no juujitsu o hakaru.
items.en: Aim to improve entertainment facilities.
items.hi: मनोरंजन सुविधाओं को समृद्ध करने का प्रयास करना।
items.gu: મનોરંજન સુવિધાઓ સમૃદ્ધ કરવાનો પ્રયાસ કરવો.
items.why: Day 4's work-and-social-life group — 娯楽施設 "entertainment facility" uses 娯楽, read ごらく.

items.q: ふきつな予感が的中する。
items.qr: Fukitsu na yokan ga tekichuu suru.
items.en: An ominous premonition comes true.
items.hi: अपशकुनी पूर्वाभास सच साबित होता है।
items.gu: અશુભ પૂર્વાભાસ સાચો પડે છે.
items.why: Day 4's work-and-social-life group — 不吉な予感 "an ominous premonition" uses 不吉, read ふきつ.

items.q: よめ姑の関係はなかなか大変だ。
items.qr: Yome shuutome no kankei wa nakanaka taihen da.
items.en: The daughter-in-law/mother-in-law relationship is quite hard.
items.hi: बहू-सास का रिश्ता काफ़ी मुश्किल होता है।
items.gu: વહુ-સાસુનો સંબંધ ઘણો અઘરો હોય છે.

opts.en: marriage (wrong kanji, not a standalone noun here)

items.why: Day 5's fortune-and-relations pair — 嫁 (⇔婿) is "a daughter-in-law," read よめ.

items.q: 今朝は庭一面にしもが降りていた。
items.qr: Kesa wa niwa ichimen ni shimo ga orite ita.
items.en: This morning the whole garden was covered in frost.
items.hi: आज सुबह पूरे बगीचे में पाला पड़ा था।
items.gu: આજે સવારે આખા બગીચામાં હિમ પડ્યું હતું.
items.why: Day 1's 気象 group — 霜が降りる "frost forms" uses 霜, read しも.

items.q: 子どもと一緒に観覧（ ）に乗る。
items.qr: Kodomo to issho ni kanran (___) ni noru.
items.en: Ride the Ferris wheel together with the kids.
items.hi: बच्चों के साथ फेरिस व्हील की सवारी करना।
items.gu: બાળકો સાથે ફેરિસ વ્હીલની સવારી કરવી.
items.why: Day 3's 覧 family — 観覧車 "a Ferris wheel" is the fixed compound (literally "a viewing vehicle").

items.q: 回覧（ ）を隣に回す。
items.qr: Kairan (___) o tonari ni mawasu.
items.en: Pass the neighborhood circular notice to next door.
items.hi: सूचना-पट्ट को पड़ोसी को भेजना।
items.gu: પરિપત્રક પડોશીને મોકલવો.
items.why: Day 3's 覧 family — 回覧板 "circulation board" is the fixed compound used by neighborhood associations.

items.q: 閲覧（ ）で新聞や雑誌を読む。
items.qr: Etsuran (___) de shinbun ya zasshi o yomu.
items.en: Read newspapers and magazines in the reading room.
items.hi: वाचन-कक्ष में अख़बार और पत्रिकाएँ पढ़ना।
items.gu: વાચનખંડમાં અખબાર અને સામયિકો વાંચવાં.
items.why: Day 3's 覧 family — 閲覧室 "reading room" is the fixed compound for a library's reading area.

items.q: 展覧（ ）に招待される。
items.qr: Tenran (___) ni shoutai sareru.
items.en: Be invited to an exhibition.
items.hi: प्रदर्शनी में आमंत्रित किया जाना।
items.gu: પ્રદર્શનમાં આમંત્રિત થવું.
items.why: Day 3's 覧 family — 展覧会 "an exhibition" is the fixed compound for a public display of art/works.

items.q: 妥協（ ）を検討する。
items.qr: Dakyou (___) o kentou suru.
items.en: Consider a compromise plan.
items.hi: समझौते की योजना पर विचार करना।
items.gu: સમાધાનની યોજના પર વિચારણા કરવી.

opts.en: (not this compound; cf. 傑作/駄作)

items.why: Day 4's work-and-social-life group — 妥協案／妥協策 "a compromise plan/measure" fixes 案 (or 策) after 妥協.

items.q: 神社で試験の合格を（ ）。
items.qr: Jinja de shiken no goukaku o (___).
items.en: I pray at the shrine for success on the exam.
items.hi: मंदिर में परीक्षा में सफलता के लिए प्रार्थना करता/करती हूँ।
items.gu: મંદિરમાં પરીક્ષામાં સફળતા માટે પ્રાર્થના કરું છું.
items.why: 合格を祈る ("pray for success") is the fixed collocation; 折る means to physically fold or break something, which cannot take 合格 as its object.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 1 · 困る・原因・囚人

items.q: 結婚式で（ ）の愛を誓う。
items.qr: Kekkonshiki de (___) no ai o chikau.
items.en: At the wedding, they vow eternal love.
items.hi: शादी में वे हमेशा के प्रेम की क़सम खाते हैं।
items.gu: લગ્નમાં તેઓ કાયમી પ્રેમના શપથ લે છે.
items.why: 永遠の愛 ("eternal love") is the standard wedding-vow phrase; 因縁 describes a fated/karmic connection (often ominous), not a romantic vow.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 1 · 困る・原因・囚人

items.q: 踏み切りで立ち（ ）していた車に電車が突っ込んだ。
items.qr: Fumikiri de tachi (___) shite ita kuruma ni densha ga tsukkonda.
items.en: A train crashed into a car that was stranded at the railway crossing.
items.hi: रेलवे क्रॉसिंग पर फँसी कार से ट्रेन टकरा गई।
items.gu: રેલવે ક્રોસિંગ પર ફસાયેલી કારને ટ્રેન અથડાઈ.

opts.en: bewilderment (not a fixed set phrase here)

items.why: 立ち往生 is the fixed idiom for a vehicle stuck/stranded in place; 困惑 describes a person's mental bewilderment, not a stalled car.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 1 · 困る・原因・囚人

items.q: 子どもたちを取り（ ）環境の変化について講演する。
items.qr: Kodomotachi o tori (___) kankyou no henka ni tsuite kouen suru.
items.en: He gives a lecture on the changes in the environment surrounding children.
items.hi: बच्चों के आस-पास के माहौल में हो रहे बदलावों पर व्याख्यान देता है।
items.gu: બાળકોની આસપાસના વાતાવરણમાં થતા ફેરફારો પર વ્યાખ્યાન આપે છે.
items.why: 取り巻く環境 ("the surrounding environment") is a fixed collocation; 率いる means to lead/command people, not to surround an abstract environment.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 1 · 困る・原因・囚人

items.q: 仕事の（ ）を上げるために、歩くことが有効だそうだ。
items.qr: Shigoto no (___) o ageru tame ni, aruku koto ga yuukou da sou da.
items.en: Apparently, walking is effective for raising work efficiency.
items.hi: कहा जाता है कि पैदल चलना काम की दक्षता बढ़ाने के लिए कारगर है।
items.gu: એવું કહેવાય છે કે ચાલવું કામની કાર્યક્ષમતા વધારવા માટે અસરકારક છે.

opts.en: thought (doesn't collocate with 上げる here)

items.why: 能率を上げる ("raise efficiency") is the standard collocation; 思考 (thought/thinking) isn't something you "raise" with a verb like 上げる in this sense.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 1 · 困る・原因・囚人

items.q: 姉は文章を書くのに（ ）いる。
items.qr: Ane wa bunshou o kaku no ni (___) iru.
items.en: My older sister excels at writing.
items.hi: मेरी बड़ी बहन लेखन में उत्कृष्ट है।
items.gu: મારી મોટી બહેન લેખનમાં ઉત્કૃષ્ટ છે.
items.why: ～に秀でている means "excels at ~"; 老いる means "to grow old" and has nothing to do with writing skill — a pure shape-confusion trap (老 vs 秀 share the 耂-ish top).
items.unit: Week 7 Day 1 · 困る・原因・囚人

items.q: 東大を出て、官僚になり、（ ）なエリートコースを歩む。
items.qr: Todai o dete, kanryou ni nari, (___) na eriito koosu o ayumu.
items.en: Graduating from Tokyo University and becoming a bureaucrat, he walks the typical elite career path.
items.hi: टोक्यो विश्वविद्यालय से स्नातक होकर, नौकरशाह बनकर, वह एक विशिष्ट कुलीन करियर पथ पर चलता है।
items.gu: ટોક્યો યુનિવર્સિટીમાંથી સ્નાતક થઈ, અધિકારી બનીને, તે એક લાક્ષણિક ચુનંદા કારકિર્દી માર્ગ પર ચાલે છે.
items.why: 典型的なエリートコース ("the typical/textbook elite path") describes a well-known pattern; 象徴的 means "symbolic," which doesn't fit describing a career route.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 2 · 隠れる・穏やか

items.q: 日本に来たばかりの頃は慣れない環境に（ ）。
items.qr: Nihon ni kita bakari no koro wa narenai kankyou ni (___).
items.en: When I had just arrived in Japan, I was bewildered by the unfamiliar environment.
items.hi: जापान आने के शुरुआती दिनों में मैं अनजान माहौल से हैरान था/थी।
items.gu: જાપાન આવ્યાના શરૂઆતના દિવસોમાં હું અજાણ્યા વાતાવરણથી મૂંઝાયો/મૂંઝાઈ હતો.
items.why: 戸惑う describes confusion from an unfamiliar situation; 悔やむ means to regret a past action, which doesn't fit "being new to an environment."
items.unit: Week 7 Day 2 · 隠れる・穏やか

items.q: 監督は部員の（ ）才能に気づいた。
items.qr: Kantoku wa buin no (___) sainou ni kizuita.
items.en: The coach noticed a team member's hidden talent.
items.hi: कोच ने टीम के सदस्य की छिपी प्रतिभा पर ध्यान दिया।
items.gu: કોચે ટીમના સભ્યની છુપી પ્રતિભા નોંધી.
items.why: 隠れた才能 ("hidden talent") is a fixed collocation; 奏でる means "to play an instrument," which doesn't describe a quality of talent itself.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 2 · 隠れる・穏やか

items.q: 弱いからといって相手を（ ）はいけない。
items.qr: Yowai kara to itte aite o (___) wa ikenai.
items.en: Just because someone seems weak doesn't mean you should look down on them.
items.hi: कमज़ोर होने की वजह से किसी को तुच्छ नहीं समझना चाहिए।
items.gu: નબળા હોવાના કારણે કોઈને તુચ્છ ન ગણવું જોઈએ.
items.why: 侮る means "to belittle/underestimate," matching "shouldn't look down on someone for being weak"; 微笑する just means "to smile."
items.unit: Week 7 Day 2 · 隠れる・穏やか

items.q: ゆで卵の（ ）をむく。
items.qr: Yudetamago no (___) o muku.
items.en: Peel the shell off a boiled egg.
items.hi: उबले अंडे का छिलका उतारना।
items.gu: બાફેલા ઈંડાનું છોડું ઉતારવું.
items.why: A hard covering like an eggshell or seashell is 殻; 皮 is used for soft skins/peels (fruit, vegetables, animal skin), not a hard shell.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 2 · 隠れる・穏やか

items.q: ウイルスの（ ）経路を調べる。
items.qr: Uirusu no (___) keiro o shiraberu.
items.en: Investigate the virus's route of infection.
items.hi: वायरस के संक्रमण के मार्ग की जाँच करना।
items.gu: વાયરસના ચેપના માર્ગની તપાસ કરવી.
items.why: 感染経路 ("route of infection") is a fixed epidemiological term; 累積 means "cumulative buildup," which doesn't pair with "route."
items.unit: Week 7 Day 2 · 隠れる・穏やか

items.q: 新人のアナウンサーが原稿を（ ）読みしている。
items.qr: Shinjin no anaunsaa ga genkou o (___) yomi shite iru.
items.en: The rookie announcer is reading the script in a flat monotone.
items.hi: नया उद्घोषक स्क्रिप्ट को बेजान लहज़े में पढ़ रहा है।
items.gu: નવો ઉદ્ઘોષક સ્ક્રિપ્ટ એકધારા સૂરમાં વાંચી રહ્યો છે.

opts.en: mistaken (誤読み isn't a standard word here)

items.why: 棒読み is the fixed word for reading in a flat, expressionless tone, exactly describing a rookie reading from a script; 誤読 exists as "misreading" but not as "誤読み" in this construction.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 3 · 再検査・再編成

items.q: ほぼ準備はできたので、あとは各自で（ ）調整してください。
items.qr: Hobo junbi wa dekita node, ato wa kakuji de (___) chousei shite kudasai.
items.en: Preparations are mostly done, so please make your own small adjustments from here.
items.hi: तैयारी लगभग पूरी हो गई है, इसलिए बाक़ी बारीक़ समायोजन ख़ुद कर लें।
items.gu: તૈયારી લગભગ પૂરી થઈ ગઈ છે, તેથી બાકીના નાના ફેરફારો જાતે કરી લેજો.

opts.en: tiny (豆調整 isn't a real word)

items.why: 微調整 ("fine-tuning") is the standard word for small adjustments; 豆 attaches to nouns like 知識 or 電球, not to 調整.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 3 · 再検査・再編成

items.q: この薬はよく効くが（ ）作用がある。
items.qr: Kono kusuri wa yoku kiku ga (___) sayou ga aru.
items.en: This medicine works well, but it has side effects.
items.hi: यह दवा अच्छी तरह असर करती है, लेकिन इसके दुष्प्रभाव हैं।
items.gu: આ દવા સારી અસર કરે છે, પણ તેની આડઅસર છે.
items.why: 副作用 ("side effect") is the fixed medical term; 助 attaches to roles like 監督 or 動詞, not to 作用.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 3 · 再検査・再編成

items.q: （ ）事情により、この度会社を辞めることになりました。
items.qr: (___) jijou ni yori, kono tabi kaisha o yameru koto ni narimashita.
items.en: Due to various circumstances, I have decided to leave the company.
items.hi: विभिन्न परिस्थितियों के कारण, मैंने कंपनी छोड़ने का निर्णय लिया है।
items.gu: વિવિધ સંજોગોને કારણે, મેં કંપની છોડવાનો નિર્ણય લીધો છે.

opts.en: sudden (急事情 isn't a set phrase)

items.why: 諸事情 is the standard euphemism for "various (unspecified) reasons," commonly used when resigning; 急 would need a different noun, like 急用.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 3 · 再検査・再編成

items.q: 彼にそんな特技があったなんて（ ）耳です。
items.qr: Kare ni sonna tokugi ga atta nante (___) mimi desu.
items.en: This is the first I've heard that he has such a skill.
items.hi: उसमें ऐसा हुनर है, यह मेरे लिए बिल्कुल नई बात है।
items.gu: તેનામાં એવી આવડત છે, એ મારા માટે તદ્દન નવી વાત છે.
items.why: 初耳 is a fixed idiom meaning "news to me / first time hearing this"; 真 attaches to nouns like 犯人 (真犯人), not to 耳.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 3 · 再検査・再編成

items.q: そうしていただけるなら、私にとっては（ ）都合です。
items.qr: Sou shite itadakeru nara, watashi ni totte wa (___) tsugou desu.
items.en: If you could do that, it would be convenient for me.
items.hi: अगर आप ऐसा कर सकें, तो यह मेरे लिए फ़ायदेमंद होगा।
items.gu: જો તમે એમ કરી શકો, તો તે મારા માટે ફાયદાકારક રહેશે.
items.why: 好都合 ("convenient/favorable") is the fixed word; 高 attaches to measurable things (高性能, 高学歴), not to an abstract 都合. Both share the same reading こう, a common trap.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 3 · 再検査・再編成

items.q: 祖母は耳が遠いので（ ）が必要だ。
items.qr: Sobo wa mimi ga tooi node (___) ga hitsuyou da.
items.en: My grandmother is hard of hearing, so she needs a hearing aid.
items.hi: मेरी दादी/नानी को कम सुनाई देता है, इसलिए उन्हें श्रवण यंत्र की ज़रूरत है।
items.gu: મારી દાદી/નાનીને ઓછું સંભળાય છે, તેથી તેમને સાંભળવાના સાધનની જરૂર છે.
items.why: 補聴器 ("hearing aid") is worn to help hearing; 聴診器 is the doctor's stethoscope, a completely different device that just happens to share the reading しんき/ちょうき pattern.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 4 · 選挙権・著作権

items.q: 習ったことはないので、（ ）で花を生けます。
items.qr: Naratta koto wa nai node, (___) de hana o ikemasu.
items.en: I've never taken lessons, so I arrange flowers my own self-taught way.
items.hi: मैंने कभी सीखा नहीं है, इसलिए अपने ही तरीक़े से फूल सजाता/सजाती हूँ।
items.gu: મેં ક્યારેય શીખ્યું નથી, તેથી હું મારી પોતાની રીતે ફૂલો ગોઠવું છું.
items.why: "Never took lessons" implies no formal style was learned, so it must be 自己流 ("my own way"); 日本流 names a specific, learnable national style, which contradicts the sentence.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 4 · 選挙権・著作権

items.q: 伝統芸能の後継者不足に（ ）を抱く。
items.qr: Dentou geinou no koukeisha busoku ni (___) o idaku.
items.en: He feels a sense of crisis about the shortage of successors in traditional arts.
items.hi: पारंपरिक कलाओं में उत्तराधिकारियों की कमी को लेकर संकट का एहसास होता है।
items.gu: પરંપરાગત કળાઓમાં અનુગામીઓની અછત અંગે સંકટની લાગણી થાય છે.
items.why: A shortage of successors is worrying, matching 危機感 ("sense of crisis"); 充実感 describes a positive feeling of fulfillment, the opposite emotional direction.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 4 · 選挙権・著作権

items.q: 土地の（ ）をめぐって争う。
items.qr: Tochi no (___) o megutte arasou.
items.en: They fight over the ownership of the land.
items.hi: ज़मीन के स्वामित्व को लेकर विवाद होता है।
items.gu: જમીનની માલિકી અંગે વિવાદ થાય છે.

opts.en: copyright (wrong domain — creative works, not land)

items.why: 所有権 applies to physical property like land; 著作権 specifically protects creative/intellectual works, not real estate.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 4 · 選挙権・著作権

items.q: 今日は（ ）に欠け、作業が進まない。
items.qr: Kyou wa (___) ni kake, sagyou ga susumanai.
items.en: Today I'm lacking in concentration, and the work isn't progressing.
items.hi: आज एकाग्रता की कमी है, और काम आगे नहीं बढ़ रहा।
items.gu: આજે એકાગ્રતાની ઉણપ છે, અને કામ આગળ વધતું નથી.

opts.en: a feeling of fatigue (doesn't fit ～に欠け)

items.why: ～に欠ける ("to lack ~") pairs naturally with an ability noun like 集中力; 疲労感 is a feeling you "have," not an ability you "lack."
items.unit: Week 7 Day 4 · 選挙権・著作権

items.q: このシャッターは（ ）です。
items.qr: Kono shattaa wa (___) desu.
items.en: This shutter is electrically operated.
items.hi: यह शटर बिजली से चलता है।
items.gu: આ શટર ઇલેક્ટ્રિકથી ચાલે છે.
items.why: ～式 describes a style/mode of operation, fitting "electrically operated"; 計算機 is a noun for a specific device (a calculator), not a description of how a shutter works.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 4 · 選挙権・著作権

items.q: 醤油を（ ）瓶で買った。
items.qr: Shouyu o (___) bin de katta.
items.en: I bought soy sauce in a traditional 1.8-liter bottle.
items.hi: मैंने सोया सॉस एक बड़ी (1.8 लीटर) पारंपरिक बोतल में ख़रीदा।
