items.gu: મેં સોયા સોસ એક મોટી (1.8 લિટર) પરંપરાગત બોટલમાં ખરીદ્યો.

opts.en: an area unit (wrong domain — area, not volume)

items.why: 一升瓶 is the fixed term for the classic large soy-sauce/sake bottle; 坪 measures land/floor area, not liquid volume.

items.q: （ ）にとどまらず、あちこちに住んでみたい。
items.qr: (___) ni todomarazu, achikochi ni sunde mitai.
items.en: I'd like to live in many different places, not just stay in one house.
items.hi: मैं एक ही घर में रुकने के बजाय, अलग-अलग जगहों पर रहना चाहता/चाहती हूँ।
items.gu: મારે એક જ ઘરમાં રહેવાને બદલે, જુદી જુદી જગ્યાએ રહેવું છે.
items.why: 一軒家 ("a single house") fits "not staying in one house, wanting to live all over"; 一箇所 ("one spot") is a place counter, not a housing type.

items.q: （ ）で漢字の辞書を引く。
items.qr: (___) de kanji no jisho o hiku.
items.en: Look up a kanji dictionary by stroke count.
items.hi: स्ट्रोक-संख्या से कांजी शब्दकोश में खोजना।
items.gu: સ્ટ્રોકની સંખ્યાથી કાંજી શબ્દકોશમાં શોધવું.
items.why: Kanji dictionaries are indexed by 画数 (number of strokes); 枚数 counts flat sheets of paper, unrelated to dictionary lookup.

items.q: 1坪は2（ ）くらいの広さだ。
items.qr: Hitotsubo wa ni (___) kurai no hirosa da.
items.en: One tsubo is about the size of two tatami mats.
items.hi: एक त्सुबो लगभग दो तातामी मैट के बराबर होता है।
items.gu: એક ત્સુબો લગભગ બે તાતામી સાદડી જેટલું હોય છે.
items.why: The table's own note confirms 1坪 ≈ 2畳; 階 counts building floors, an unrelated unit of "height," not area.

items.q: 母は（ ）も同じことを言うようになった。
items.qr: Haha wa (___) mo onaji koto o iu you ni natta.
items.en: My mother has started saying the same thing over and over.
items.hi: माँ अब बार-बार वही बात कहने लगी हैं।
items.gu: મા હવે વારંવાર એ જ વાત કહેવા લાગ્યાં છે.
items.why: 何遍も ("time and time again") counts repeated actions; 隻 counts large ships, irrelevant to "saying something."

items.q: 食パンを（ ）ください。
items.qr: Shokupan o (___) kudasai.
items.en: A loaf of bread, please.
items.hi: एक पाव रोटी दीजिए, कृपया।
items.gu: એક બ્રેડનો લોટ આપો, કૃપા કરીને.
items.why: 斤 is the dedicated counter for loaves of sliced bread; 錠 counts pills/tablets, an unrelated small solid object.

items.q: 神社に試験の合格を祈願する。
items.qr: Jinja ni shiken no goukaku o kigan suru.
items.why: Day 1's 祈 cluster gives 祈願 (きがん) directly — "praying at a shrine for success."

items.q: 彼は後輩から慕われている。
items.qr: Kare wa kouhai kara shitawarete iru.
items.why: Day 1's 墓・暮・募・慕・幕 cluster gives 慕う (したう) — "he is looked up to by his juniors."

items.q: 便宜上、その人をAさんと呼ぶことにします。
items.qr: Bengijou, sono hito o Ei-san to yobu koto ni shimasu.
items.why: Day 2's 宜 cluster gives 適宜 (てきぎ) and 便宜上 (べんぎじょう) — "for convenience's sake."

items.q: 私は派遣社員から正社員になった。
items.qr: Watashi wa haken shain kara seishain ni natta.
items.why: Day 2's 遺・遣 cluster gives 派遣 (はけん) — "I went from being a dispatched (temp) worker to a full employee."

items.q: 遺族に対して哀悼の意を表した。
items.qr: Izoku ni taishite aitou no i o arawashita.
items.why: Day 2's 哀・衰 cluster gives 哀悼 (あいとう) — "expressed condolences to the bereaved family."

items.q: 「奉仕品」というのは安売りのことだ。
items.qr: "Houshi hin" to iu no wa yasuuri no koto da.
items.why: Day 2's 奉・奏 cluster gives 奉仕 (ほうし) — "a service item" is a Japanese retail term for a discounted bargain good.

items.q: その商品は在庫がございます。
items.qr: Sono shouhin wa zaiko ga gozaimasu.
items.why: Day 2's 存・在 cluster gives 在庫 (ざいこ) — "that item is in stock."

items.q: ピアノの伴奏で歌を歌う。
items.qr: Piano no bansou de uta o utau.
items.why: Day 2's 奉・奏 cluster gives 伴奏 (ばんそう) — "singing to piano accompaniment."

items.q: 平穏無事な毎日を送る。
items.qr: Heion buji na mainichi o okuru.
items.why: Day 2's title kanji 穏 gives 平穏 (へいおん) — "living a peaceful, uneventful daily life."

items.q: あの日のことは今でも鮮明に覚えている。
items.qr: Ano hi no koto wa ima demo senmei ni oboete iru.
items.why: Day 6's 鮮明な cluster gives せんめい — "I still remember that day vividly."

items.q: ゆいごん状を書いておく。
items.qr: Yuigon jou o kaite oku.
items.why: Day 2's headline confusion pair 遺 vs 遣 — a will is 遺言, written with "leave behind," never 遣.

items.q: さよならまんるいホームランで勝った。
items.qr: Sayonara manrui hoomuran de katta.
items.why: Day 2's 塁・累 cluster gives 満塁 (まんるい) — "won with a walk-off grand slam."

items.q: はものの持ち込みは禁止されています。
items.qr: Hamono no mochikomi wa kinshi sarete imasu.
items.why: Day 1's 力・刀・刃 cluster gives 刃物 (はもの) — "bringing in blades is prohibited."

items.q: お金とは一生えんがないだろうと占い師に言われた。
items.qr: Okane to wa isshou en ga nai darou to uranaishi ni iwareta.
items.why: Day 1's 緑・録・縁 cluster gives 縁 (えん) — "the fortune-teller said I'd never have a connection with money."

items.q: そぼくな疑問をぶつけてみた。
items.qr: Soboku na gimon o butsukete mita.
items.why: Day 1's 牧・枚・朴 cluster gives 素朴な (そぼく) — "I raised a naive/basic question."

items.q: 飛行機は（ ）気流に巻き込まれた。
items.qr: Hikouki wa (___) kiryuu ni makikomareta.
items.why: Day 3's 中級 cluster gives 乱気流 (らんきりゅう) — "the plane was caught in turbulence."

items.q: エコーと呼ばれる（ ）音波による検査を受ける。
items.qr: Ekoo to yobareru (___) onpa ni yoru kensa o ukeru.
items.why: Day 3's 初級 cluster gives 超音波 (ちょうおんぱ) — the fixed term for medical ultrasound ("echo").

items.q: 真っ暗は嫌なので、（ ）電球だけつけて寝ます。
items.qr: Makkura wa iya na node, (___) denkyuu dake tsukete nemasu.
items.why: Day 3's 上級 cluster gives 豆電球 (まめでんきゅう) — "I sleep with just a small night-light on since I hate total darkness."

items.q: 日本（ ）公開の古い映画を見に行く。
items.qr: Nihon (___) koukai no furui eiga o mi ni iku.
items.why: Day 3's 中級 cluster gives 初公開 (はつこうかい) — "going to see an old movie's Japan premiere."

items.q: （ ）文化間コミュニケーションを学ぶ。
items.qr: (___) bunka kan komyunikeeshon o manabu.
items.why: Day 3's 中級 cluster gives 異文化 (いぶんか) — "studying cross-cultural communication."

items.q: 市長は市立博物館の館長を（ ）して組織を一新したいと述べた。
items.qr: Shichou wa shiritsu hakubutsukan no kanchou o (___) shite soshiki o isshin shitai to nobeta.
items.en: The mayor said he wants to replace the city museum's director and renew the organization.
items.hi: मेयर ने कहा कि वे शहर के संग्रहालय के निदेशक को बदलकर संगठन का कायाकल्प करना चाहते हैं।
items.gu: મેયરે કહ્યું કે તેઓ શહેરના મ્યુઝિયમના ડિરેક્ટરને બદલીને સંસ્થાનું નવીનીકરણ કરવા માંગે છે.
items.why: 更迭 targets a person in a post being replaced — exactly "館長を更迭する"; 統合 means merging/integrating organizations or systems, not swapping out one person.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 1 · 政治について

items.q: 新（ ）が発足してから1年が経過した。
items.qr: Shin (___) ga hossoku shite kara ichi-nen ga keika shita.
items.en: A year has passed since the new cabinet was formed.
items.hi: नए मंत्रिमंडल के गठन को एक साल बीत चुका है।
items.gu: નવા મંત્રીમંડળની રચનાને એક વર્ષ થઈ ગયું છે.
items.why: 内閣発足 (the cabinet's formation/launch) is the book's own fixed collocation; 閣僚 refers to individual ministers, who are appointed, not "launched" as a group.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 1 · 政治について

items.q: 公共事業をめぐる（ ）事件で町長が起訴された。
items.qr: Koukyou jigyou o meguru (___) jiken de choushou ga kiso sareta.
items.en: The town mayor was indicted in a bribery scandal involving public works.
items.hi: सार्वजनिक निर्माण-कार्यों से जुड़े घूसखोरी के मामले में नगर प्रमुख पर मुक़दमा चलाया गया।
items.gu: જાહેર બાંધકામ પ્રોજેક્ટ સાથે સંકળાયેલા લાંચરુશવતના કેસમાં નગરના મુખ્યાધિકારી પર કામ ચલાવવામાં આવ્યું.

opts.en: dismissal (an action, not a type of scandal)

items.why: 贈収賄事件 (bribery scandal/case) is the standard news term for a giving-and-receiving-bribes case; 罷免 is the separate act of formally dismissing someone from a post, not a kind of "事件."
items.unit: Week 8 Day 1 · 政治について

items.q: （ ）改正について考える会が開かれた。
items.qr: (___) kaisei ni tsuite kangaeru kai ga hirakareta.
items.en: A meeting was held to think about constitutional reform.
items.hi: संविधान में संशोधन पर विचार करने के लिए एक बैठक आयोजित हुई।
items.gu: બંધારણમાં સુધારા વિશે વિચારવા માટે એક સભા યોજાઈ.

opts.en: unconstitutional (a state, not a document to amend)

items.why: 憲法改正 (constitutional amendment) is the fixed phrase — you amend the 憲法 itself; 違憲 describes something being unconstitutional, and "違憲を改正する" is not meaningful.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 1 · 政治について

items.q: 選挙に出馬というのは（ ）するという意味だ。
items.qr: Senkyo ni shutsuba to iu no wa (___) suru to iu imi da.
items.en: "Running (出馬) in an election" means to stand as a candidate.
items.hi: चुनाव में "出馬" का मतलब है उम्मीदवार के रूप में खड़ा होना।
items.gu: ચૂંટણીમાં "出馬" નો અર્થ છે ઉમેદવાર તરીકે ઊભા રહેવું.
items.why: 出馬 and 立候補 are near-synonyms for entering a race as a candidate; 総辞職 is a cabinet or group stepping down together — the opposite kind of event.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 1 · 政治について

items.q: 来月中旬に日米（ ）会談が開かれる予定だ。
items.qr: Raigetsu chuujun ni Nichi-Bei (___) kaidan ga hirakareru yotei da.
items.en: A Japan-US summit is scheduled to be held in the middle of next month.
items.hi: अगले महीने के मध्य में जापान-अमेरिका शिखर वार्ता होने वाली है।
items.gu: આવતા મહિનાના મધ્યમાં જાપાન-અમેરિકા શિખર મંત્રણા યોજાવાની છે.

opts.en: alliance (the relationship itself, not the meeting)

items.why: 首脳会談 (summit talks) is the standard term for a meeting between national leaders; 同盟 names the alliance relationship itself, not the meeting where leaders talk.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 1 · 政治について

items.q: 各地で大雨による（ ）警報が出される。
items.qr: Kakuchi de oo-ame ni yoru (___) keihou ga dasareru.
items.en: Flood warnings are issued in various places due to heavy rain.
items.hi: भारी बारिश के कारण कई जगहों पर बाढ़ की चेतावनी जारी की जाती है।
items.gu: ભારે વરસાદને કારણે અનેક સ્થળોએ પૂરની ચેતવણી જારી કરવામાં આવે છે.
items.why: 洪水警報 is the fixed term for a flood warning triggered by heavy rain; 津波 (tsunami) is caused by seismic activity, not rainfall.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 2 · 国際問題について

items.q: 核実験を続ける国に対し、経済（ ）措置をとる。
items.qr: Kaku jikken o tsuzukeru kuni ni taishi, keizai (___) sochi o toru.
items.en: Economic sanction measures are taken against a country that continues nuclear testing.
items.hi: परमाणु परीक्षण जारी रखने वाले देश के ख़िलाफ़ आर्थिक प्रतिबंध लगाए जाते हैं।
items.gu: પરમાણુ પરીક્ષણ ચાલુ રાખતા દેશ સામે આર્થિક પ્રતિબંધનાં પગલાં લેવામાં આવે છે.
items.why: 経済制裁措置 (economic sanction measures) is the book's own listed collocation for punishing a state; 救援 is aid given to victims, the opposite kind of action.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 2 · 国際問題について

items.q: 森林（ ）の現状について環境省が報告をした。
items.qr: Shinrin (___) no genjou ni tsuite Kankyoushou ga houkoku o shita.
items.en: The Ministry of the Environment reported on the current state of deforestation.
items.hi: पर्यावरण मंत्रालय ने वनों की कटाई की मौजूदा स्थिति पर रिपोर्ट दी।
items.gu: પર્યાવરણ મંત્રાલયે વનનાબૂદીની હાલની સ્થિતિ પર અહેવાલ આપ્યો.

opts.en: a disaster (too broad, no specific act)

items.why: 森林伐採 (deforestation/logging) is today's headline term and the book's fixed collocation; 災害 is a general disaster, not the specific act of cutting down forests.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 2 · 国際問題について

items.q: 世界的な（ ）危機、穀物の不足などが心配されている。
items.qr: Sekaiteki na (___) kiki, kokumotsu no fusoku nado ga shinpai sarete iru.
items.en: A global food crisis and grain shortages are feared.
items.hi: वैश्विक खाद्य संकट और अनाज की कमी जैसी चिंताएँ जताई जा रही हैं।
items.gu: વૈશ્વિક ખાદ્ય કટોકટી અને અનાજની અછત જેવી ચિંતાઓ વ્યક્ત કરવામાં આવી રહી છે.

opts.en: hunger/starvation (a state, not this set phrase)

items.why: 食糧危機 (food crisis) is the book's own listed fixed phrase; 飢餓 names the resulting state of starvation rather than the crisis itself.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 2 · 国際問題について

items.q: 海外の地震被災地で（ ）活動をする。
items.qr: Kaigai no jishin hisaichi de (___) katsudou o suru.
items.en: Relief activities are carried out in areas overseas struck by an earthquake.
items.hi: विदेश में भूकंप-पीड़ित क्षेत्रों में राहत गतिविधियाँ की जाती हैं।
items.gu: વિદેશમાં ધરતીકંપ-પીડિત વિસ્તારોમાં રાહત પ્રવૃત્તિઓ કરવામાં આવે છે.

opts.en: a request (an act of asking, not "活動")

items.why: 救援活動 (relief activities) is the book's own listed collocation; 要請 is the act of requesting help, not the activity of providing it.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 2 · 国際問題について

items.q: （ ）上の理由から、空港での検査を拒否した人がいる。
items.qr: (___) jou no riyuu kara, kuukou de no kensa o kyohi shita hito ga iru.
items.en: Some people have refused airport screening for religious reasons.
items.hi: धार्मिक कारणों से हवाई अड्डे पर जाँच से इनकार करने वाले लोग भी हैं।
items.gu: ધાર્મિક કારણોસર એરપોર્ટ પર તપાસનો ઇનકાર કરનારા લોકો પણ છે.
items.why: 宗教上の理由 (for religious reasons) is the book's own listed fixed phrase; 弁護 relates to legal defense, not personal-belief reasons for refusing an inspection.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 2 · 国際問題について

items.q: 食材の相次ぐ値上がりに庶民の食卓は（ ）を受けている。
items.qr: Shokuzai no aitsugu neagari ni shomin no shokutaku wa (___) o ukete iru.
items.en: Ordinary people's dinner tables are taking a hit from successive food-price hikes.
items.hi: लगातार बढ़ती खाद्य क़ीमतों से आम जनता की रसोई पर आघात पड़ रहा है।
items.gu: સતત વધતા ખાદ્ય ભાવોથી સામાન્ય લોકોના રસોડા પર ફટકો પડી રહ્યો છે.

opts.en: an attack (too aggressive for a "dinner table")

items.why: 打撃を受ける (to take a hit/blow) is the natural collocation for something suffering economic harm; 攻撃 implies an aggressive act by an agent, which doesn't fit "食卓" (a dinner table).
items.unit: Week 8 Day 3 · 経済・産業について

items.q: 円高差益を（ ）して値下げをする。
items.qr: Endaka saeki o (___) shite nesage o suru.
items.en: Prices are cut by returning the profit margin from yen appreciation.
items.hi: येन की मज़बूती से हुए मुनाफ़े को वापस लौटाकर क़ीमतें घटाई जाती हैं।
items.gu: યેનની મજબૂતીથી થયેલો નફો પાછો આપીને ભાવ ઘટાડવામાં આવે છે.
items.why: 利益を還元する (return a profit to customers) is the book's own listed collocation; 返還 is used for returning territory or physical objects, not abstract profit margins.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 3 · 経済・産業について

items.q: A社が子会社2社を吸収（ ）することになった。
items.qr: A-sha ga kogaisha ni-sha o kyuushuu (___) suru koto ni natta.
items.en: Company A is set to absorb and merge with its two subsidiaries.
items.hi: कंपनी A अपनी दो सहायक कंपनियों का अधिग्रहण-विलय करेगी।
items.gu: કંપની A તેની બે પેટાકંપનીઓનું શોષણ-વિલિનીકરણ કરશે.
items.why: 吸収合併 (absorption merger) is the book's own fixed phrase; 倒産 (bankruptcy) is something that happens to a company, not an action one company does to another.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 3 · 経済・産業について

items.q: 解雇等で職を失った人を対象に（ ）する国の制度がある。
items.qr: Kaiko tou de shoku o ushinatta hito o taishou ni (___) suru kuni no seido ga aru.
items.en: There is a national system that provides loans targeting people who lost their jobs through layoffs, etc.
items.hi: छँटनी आदि से नौकरी खो चुके लोगों के लिए एक राष्ट्रीय ऋण-योजना है।
items.gu: છટણી વગેરેથી નોકરી ગુમાવેલા લોકો માટે એક રાષ્ટ્રીય ધિરાણ યોજના છે.

opts.en: finance (the field, doesn't take する this way)

items.why: 融資する (to lend/finance someone) is a verb describing an act of lending; 金融 names the general field of finance and doesn't naturally take する to mean "lend to a person."
items.unit: Week 8 Day 3 · 経済・産業について

items.q: 男性に人気のファストフード店が女性や子どもの需要（ ）を検討している。
items.qr: Dansei ni ninki no fasuto fuudo-ten ga josei ya kodomo no juyou (___) o kentou shite iru.
items.en: A fast-food chain popular with men is considering tapping into demand from women and children.
items.hi: पुरुषों में लोकप्रिय एक फ़ास्ट-फ़ूड चेन महिलाओं और बच्चों की माँग को नया बाज़ार बनाने पर विचार कर रही है।
items.gu: પુરુષોમાં લોકપ્રિય એક ફાસ્ટ-ફૂડ ચેઇન મહિલાઓ અને બાળકોની માંગને નવું બજાર બનાવવા વિચારી રહી છે.

opts.en: a profit (a noun, not something you "検討" as an action on demand)

items.why: 需要を開拓する (to cultivate/tap new demand) matches the book's own ◆新分野を開拓 pattern; 利益 (profit) is a result, not an action taken toward "需要."
items.unit: Week 8 Day 3 · 経済・産業について

items.q: 職業訓練と就職先（ ）の雇用支援制度を設ける。
items.qr: Shokugyou kunren to shuushoku-saki (___) no koyou shien seido o mookeru.
items.en: An employment support system is set up covering vocational training and job-placement mediation.
items.hi: व्यावसायिक प्रशिक्षण और नौकरी दिलवाने में सहायता वाली रोज़गार-सहायता योजना बनाई जाती है।
items.gu: વ્યાવસાયિક તાલીમ અને નોકરી અપાવવામાં મદદરૂપ રોજગાર-સહાય યોજના બનાવવામાં આવે છે.

opts.en: recommendation (endorsing one candidate, not a placement service)

items.why: 就職先の斡旋 (job-placement mediation) is today's own vocabulary term for institutional employment-matching; 推薦 is a personal endorsement of one candidate, a narrower act.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 3 · 経済・産業について

items.q: 平均（ ）が年々更新されている。
items.qr: Heikin (___) ga nen'nen koushin sarete iru.
items.en: The average life expectancy is being renewed (extended) year after year.
items.hi: औसत जीवन-प्रत्याशा हर साल नया रिकॉर्ड बना रही है।
items.gu: સરેરાશ આયુષ્ય દર વર્ષે નવો રેકોર્ડ બનાવી રહ્યું છે.

opts.en: a lifetime (a span, not a measurable statistic here)

items.why: 平均寿命 (average life expectancy) is the book's own fixed statistical term; 生涯 names a person's whole lifetime as a span, not the average-年数 figure being "updated."
items.unit: Week 8 Day 4 · 医療・福祉・健康について

items.q: この薬は、花粉症による目のかゆみや（ ）を抑えます。
items.qr: Kono kusuri wa, kafunshou ni yoru me no kayumi ya (___) o osaemasu.
items.en: This medicine suppresses eye itchiness and inflammation caused by hay fever.
items.hi: यह दवा एलर्जी से होने वाली आँखों की खुजली और सूजन को कम करती है।
items.gu: આ દવા એલર્જીથી થતી આંખની ખંજવાળ અને સોજો ઘટાડે છે.

opts.en: pneumonia (a lung disease, unrelated to eyes)

items.why: 炎症 (inflammation) fits eye symptoms from allergies; 肺炎 (pneumonia) is specifically a lung infection, unrelated to hay-fever eye symptoms.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 4 · 医療・福祉・健康について

items.q: 保育所の職員が児童（ ）法違反で取り調べを受けた。
items.qr: Hoikusho no shokuin ga jidou (___) hou ihan de torishirabe o uketa.
items.en: A daycare employee was investigated for violating the Child Welfare Act.
items.hi: एक डे-केयर कर्मचारी की बाल-कल्याण अधिनियम के उल्लंघन के लिए जाँच हुई।
items.gu: એક ડે-કેર કર્મચારીની બાળ કલ્યાણ કાયદાના ભંગ બદલ તપાસ થઈ.
items.why: 児童福祉法 (the Child Welfare Act) is a real Japanese law name, matching the book's own ◆児童福祉 entry; 奉仕 (service) isn't part of any such law's name.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 4 · 医療・福祉・健康について

items.q: 喘息など（ ）疾患のある人は、ワクチンを優先的に受けられます。
items.qr: Zensoku nado (___) shikkan no aru hito wa, wakuchin o yuusenteki ni ukeraremasu.
items.en: People with underlying conditions such as asthma can receive the vaccine on a priority basis.
items.hi: अस्थमा जैसी अंतर्निहित बीमारियों वाले लोगों को प्राथमिकता के आधार पर टीका मिल सकता है।
items.gu: અસ્થમા જેવી અંતર્ગત બીમારીઓ ધરાવતા લોકોને પ્રાથમિકતાના ધોરણે રસી મળી શકે છે.

opts.en: stomach and intestines (asthma isn't a GI example)

items.why: 基礎疾患 (underlying/pre-existing medical condition) is the book's own fixed phrase for comorbidities like asthma; 胃腸 refers specifically to the stomach/intestines, unrelated to asthma.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 4 · 医療・福祉・健康について

items.q: ある病院で脳卒中の患者に自立歩行を（ ）し、効果を上げている。
items.qr: Aru byouin de nousocchuu no kanja ni jiritsu hokou o (___) shi, kouka o agete iru.
items.en: At one hospital, stroke patients are being encouraged to walk independently, with good results.
items.hi: एक अस्पताल में स्ट्रोक-पीड़ितों को स्वतंत्र रूप से चलने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया जा रहा है, और अच्छे परिणाम मिल रहे हैं।
items.gu: એક હોસ્પિટલમાં સ્ટ્રોકના દર્દીઓને સ્વતંત્ર રીતે ચાલવા પ્રોત્સાહિત કરવામાં આવે છે, અને સારા પરિણામો મળી રહ્યા છે.
items.why: 奨励する fits promoting a therapeutic practice as institutional policy; 激励 is more about cheering on one person emotionally (e.g. a competing athlete), a different register.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 4 · 医療・福祉・健康について

items.q: 親が子どもに暴力を（ ）事件が相次いでいる。
items.qr: Oya ga kodomo ni bouryoku o (___) jiken ga aitsuide iru.
items.en: Incidents of parents using violence against their children are occurring one after another.
items.hi: माता-पिता द्वारा बच्चों पर हिंसा करने की घटनाएँ लगातार सामने आ रही हैं।
items.gu: માતા-પિતા દ્વારા બાળકો પર હિંસા કરવાના બનાવો સતત સામે આવી રહ્યા છે.
items.why: 暴力を振るう (to wield violence) is the book's own fixed collocation; 吐く combines with things "spit out" like words (吐く言葉), not with 暴力.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 4 · 医療・福祉・健康について

items.q: 登山ブームの中で（ ）件数も増加している。
items.qr: Tozan buumu no naka de (___) kensuu mo zouka shite iru.
items.en: Amid the mountain-climbing boom, the number of mountaineering accidents is also increasing.
items.hi: पर्वतारोहण की लोकप्रियता के बीच, दुर्घटनाओं की संख्या भी बढ़ रही है।
items.gu: પર્વતારોહણની લોકપ્રિયતા વચ્ચે, અકસ્માતોની સંખ્યા પણ વધી રહી છે.
items.why: 遭難 is the standard term for a mountaineering/maritime mishap; 侵略 refers to a military invasion and has nothing to do with hikers.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 5 · 事件・事故について

items.q: 現場に残された（ ）が容疑者のものと一致した。
items.qr: Genba ni nokosareta (___) ga yougisha no mono to icchi shita.
items.en: The fingerprints left at the scene matched the suspect's.
items.hi: घटनास्थल पर मिले उँगलियों के निशान संदिग्ध के निशानों से मेल खाए।
items.gu: ઘટનાસ્થળે મળેલી આંગળીની છાપ શંકાસ્પદ વ્યક્તિની છાપ સાથે મળતી આવી.

opts.en: a person's custody/identity (a person, not something left behind)

items.why: 指紋が一致する (fingerprints match) is the exact phrase from today's headline; 身柄 refers to a person's physical custody, not physical evidence that can "match."
items.unit: Week 8 Day 5 · 事件・事故について

items.q: （ ）されていた会社社長は無事保護された。
items.qr: (___) sarete ita kaisha shachou wa buji hogo sareta.
items.en: The company president, who had been kidnapped, was safely taken into protective custody.
items.hi: अपहृत कंपनी अध्यक्ष को सुरक्षित रूप से बचा लिया गया।
items.gu: અપહૃત કંપની પ્રમુખને સુરક્ષિત રીતે બચાવી લેવાયા.

opts.en: release (would make "was then safely protected" redundant)

items.why: The sentence needs the state the president was in *before* being rescued — kidnapped (誘拐された); 解放 (already released) would make the following "was safely protected" nonsensical.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 5 · 事件・事故について

items.q: 行政に失望し、選挙を（ ）した。
items.qr: Gyousei ni shitsubou shi, senkyo o (___) shita.
items.en: Disillusioned with the administration, he/she abstained from voting in the election.
items.hi: प्रशासन से निराश होकर, उसने चुनाव में मतदान से परहेज़ किया।
items.gu: વહીવટીતંત્રથી નિરાશ થઈને, તેમણે ચૂંટણીમાં મતદાનથી દૂર રહેવાનું પસંદ કર્યું.
items.why: 選挙を棄権する (abstaining from an election) is the book's own listed collocation; 黙秘 is specifically a suspect's right to remain silent under questioning, unrelated to voting.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 5 · 事件・事故について

items.q: 男は住居侵入の容疑で（ ）された。
items.qr: Otoko wa juukyo shinnyuu no yougi de (___) sareta.
items.en: The man was arrested on suspicion of trespassing.
items.hi: घर में अवैध प्रवेश के संदेह में उस व्यक्ति को गिरफ़्तार किया गया।
items.gu: ઘરમાં ગેરકાયદે પ્રવેશની શંકામાં તે વ્યક્તિની ધરપકડ કરવામાં આવી.

opts.en: release (the opposite direction from "on suspicion of")

items.why: 容疑で逮捕される (arrested on suspicion of) is the standard news pattern; 容疑で釈放される (released on suspicion of) would be contradictory, since release resolves a suspicion rather than acting on it.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 5 · 事件・事故について

items.q: MOMAという美術館の正式な（ ）をご存知ですか。
items.qr: MOMA to iu bijutsukan no seishiki na (___) o gozonji desu ka.
items.en: Do you know the official name of the museum called MOMA?
items.hi: क्या आपको MOMA नामक संग्रहालय का आधिकारिक नाम पता है?
items.gu: શું તમને MOMA નામના મ્યુઝિયમનું સત્તાવાર નામ ખબર છે?

opts.en: self-styled (a person claiming a title, not an institution's real name)

items.why: 正式な名称 (official name) is the book's own listed phrase for a formal designation; 自称 describes a person self-declaring a title, not an institution's real name.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 5 · 事件・事故について

items.q: 違法薬物取り締まり強化で、抜き打ち（ ）検査を実施する。
items.qr: Ihou yakubutsu torishimari kyouka de, nukiuchi (___) kensa o jisshi suru.
items.en: With stronger crackdowns on illegal drugs, surprise urine tests are carried out.
items.hi: अवैध नशीले पदार्थों पर सख़्ती के तहत अचानक मूत्र-जाँच की जाती है।
items.gu: ગેરકાયદે નશીલા પદાર્થો પર કડકાઈ સાથે અચાનક પેશાબ પરીક્ષણ કરવામાં આવે છે.
items.why: 尿検査 (urine test) is the book's own listed collocation and the real-world method for drug testing; 腸 (intestines) has no such testing use.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 6 · 社会について

items.q: 高度成長から経済大国への（ ）を振り返る。
items.qr: Koudo seichou kara keizai taikoku e no (___) o furikaeru.
items.en: Looking back at the transition from a period of rapid growth to becoming an economic power.
items.hi: तीव्र आर्थिक विकास से आर्थिक महाशक्ति बनने तक के बदलाव पर एक नज़र।
items.gu: ઝડપી આર્થિક વિકાસથી આર્થિક મહાસત્તા બનવા સુધીના પરિવર્તન પર નજર.
items.why: 変遷 (historical transition/changes) fits a decades-long economic narrative; 返還 refers to returning territory or objects, unrelated to describing gradual change.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 6 · 社会について

items.q: 空港の拡張で（ ）被害が懸念される。
items.qr: Kuukou no kakuchou de (___) higai ga kenen sareru.
items.en: With the airport's expansion, damage from noise is a concern.
items.hi: हवाई अड्डे के विस्तार से शोर-जनित नुक़सान की चिंता है।
items.gu: એરપોર્ટના વિસ્તરણથી અવાજને લીધે થતા નુકસાનની ચિંતા છે.

opts.en: a disturbance/riot (a commotion, not ambient sound)

items.why: 騒音 (noise, esp. from aircraft) is the correct term for the kind of pollution airport expansion causes; 騒動 describes an uproar or social disturbance, not ambient sound.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 6 · 社会について

items.q: 被害者に（ ）にメールを送っていた男が捜査線上に浮かび上がった。
items.qr: Higaisha ni (___) ni meeru o okutte ita otoko ga sousa-senjou ni ukabiagatta.
items.en: A man who had frequently sent emails to the victim emerged as a person of interest in the investigation.
items.hi: पीड़िता को बार-बार ई-मेल भेजने वाला एक व्यक्ति जाँच में संदिग्ध के रूप में सामने आया।
items.gu: પીડિતાને વારંવાર ઈમેલ મોકલનાર એક વ્યક્તિ તપાસમાં શંકાસ્પદ તરીકે સામે આવ્યો.

opts.en: prosperity (a noun, doesn't work adverbially here)

items.why: 頻繁に (frequently) is the adverbial form used before a verb like メールを送る; 繁栄 (prosperity) is a noun about economic/social flourishing, not usable this way.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 6 · 社会について

items.q: A氏がB球団の新（ ）に就任した。
items.qr: A-shi ga B kyuudan no shin (___) ni shuunin shita.
items.en: Mr. A has taken up the post of new manager of team B.
items.hi: श्री A ने टीम B के नए कोच का पद संभाला।
items.gu: શ્રી Aએ ટીમ Bના નવા કોચનું પદ સંભાળ્યું.

opts.en: a guest (an attendee, not a post one takes up)

items.why: 監督に就任する (to take up the post of manager) matches today's headline about a coach becoming an honorary citizen; 来賓 names an invited guest, not an appointed position.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 6 · 社会について

items.q: （ ）化の進む村で、地域の振興と活性化を図るイベントが行われた。
items.qr: (___)-ka no susumu mura de, chiiki no shinkou to kasseika o hakaru ibento ga okonawareta.
items.en: In a village experiencing advancing depopulation, an event was held aiming at regional promotion and revitalization.
items.hi: जनसंख्या-ह्रास से जूझ रहे एक गाँव में क्षेत्रीय पुनरुद्धार हेतु आयोजन किया गया।
items.gu: વસ્તી ઘટાડાનો સામનો કરી રહેલા એક ગામમાં પ્રાદેશિક પુનરુત્થાન માટે કાર્યક્રમ યોજાયો.

opts.en: overcrowding (happens in cities, not shrinking villages)

items.why: 過疎化 (depopulation) fits a village needing "regional revitalization"; 過密 describes overcrowding, the opposite demographic problem seen in large cities.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 6 · 社会について

items.q: 病気を克服して社会に復帰する。
items.qr: Byouki o kokufuku shite shakai ni fukki suru.
items.en: Overcome an illness and return to society.
items.hi: बीमारी पर विजय पाकर समाज में वापस लौटना।
items.gu: બીમારી પર વિજય મેળવીને સમાજમાં પાછા ફરવું.
items.why: Day 6's 克 entry gives 克服 (こくふく) directly, matching the "○○監督" headline about overcoming illness.

items.q: 児童虐待事件の再発防止に取り組む。
items.qr: Jidou gyakutai jiken no sai-hatsu boushi ni torikumu.
items.en: Work to prevent recurrence of child-abuse incidents.
items.hi: बाल-उत्पीड़न की घटनाओं की पुनरावृत्ति रोकने का प्रयास करना।
items.gu: બાળ-ત્રાસના બનાવોનું પુનરાવર્તન અટકાવવાનો પ્રયાસ કરવો.
items.why: Day 6's 虐 entry gives 虐待 (ぎゃくたい), matching the headline "頻繁に起こる児童虐待."

items.q: 皇太子様がA国首相を表敬訪問した。
items.qr: Koutaishi-sama ga A-koku shushou o hyoukei houmon shita.
items.en: The Crown Prince paid a courtesy visit to the Prime Minister of Country A.
items.hi: युवराज ने देश A के प्रधानमंत्री से शिष्टाचार भेंट की।
items.gu: યુવરાજે દેશ Aના વડાપ્રધાનની સૌજન્ય મુલાકાત લીધી.
items.why: Day 6's 皇 entry gives 皇太子 (こうたいし), the Crown Prince.

items.q: B市教育委員会は給食費の滞納に対して法的措置を申し立てた。
items.qr: B-shi kyouiku iinkai wa kyuushokuhi no tainou ni taishite houteki sochi o moushitateta.
items.en: City B's board of education filed for legal measures against unpaid school-lunch fees.
items.hi: शहर B के शिक्षा बोर्ड ने मिड-डे मील शुल्क न चुकाने पर क़ानूनी क़दम उठाने का आवेदन दिया।
items.gu: શહેર Bના શિક્ષણ બોર્ડે મધ્યાહન ભોજન ફી ન ભરવા બદલ કાનૂની પગલાં માટે અરજી કરી.
items.why: Day 2's 措 entry gives 措置 (そち), matching the book's own ◆法的措置.

items.q: エコカーの大衆化が進んでいる。
items.qr: Ekokaa no taishuuka ga susunde iru.
items.en: The popularization of eco-friendly cars is progressing.
items.hi: पर्यावरण-अनुकूल कारों का लोकप्रिय होना जारी है।
items.gu: ઈકો-ફ્રેન્ડલી કારનું લોકપ્રિય થવું ચાલુ છે.
items.why: Day 1's 衆 entry gives 大衆 (たいしゅう, the general public); 大衆化 extends it to mean "becoming mainstream/popularized."

items.q: 派遣法の改正で雇用情勢が悪化する懸念がある。
items.qr: Haken-hou no kaisei de koyou jousei ga akka suru kenen ga aru.
items.en: There are concerns that revising the temp-staffing law will worsen the employment situation.
items.hi: अस्थायी-कर्मचारी क़ानून में संशोधन से रोज़गार की स्थिति बिगड़ने की आशंका है।
items.gu: કામચલાઉ કર્મચારી કાયદામાં સુધારાથી રોજગારની સ્થિતિ બગડવાની ચિંતા છે.
items.why: Day 3's 関連語彙 gives 雇用 (こよう, employment) ⇔ 解雇 (かいこ, dismissal).

items.q: A工業が昨年来、高値を更新している。
items.qr: A Kougyou ga sakunen-rai, takane o koushin shite iru.
items.en: A Industries has been hitting new record-high prices since last year.
items.hi: A इंडस्ट्रीज़ पिछले साल से लगातार नया उच्चतम मूल्य दर्ज कर रही है।
items.gu: A ઇન્ડસ્ટ્રીઝ ગયા વર્ષથી સતત નવો ઉચ્ચતમ ભાવ નોંધાવી રહી છે.
items.why: Day 3's 関連語彙 gives 高値更新 (たかねこうしん, a record-high price), a stock-market term.

items.q: 胃腸の調子が悪く吐き気もする。
items.qr: Ichou no choushi ga waruku hakike mo suru.
items.en: My stomach is upset, and I also feel nauseated.
items.hi: पेट ख़राब है और मिचली भी महसूस हो रही है।
items.gu: પેટ ખરાબ છે અને ઊબકા પણ આવે છે.
items.why: Day 4's 吐 entry gives 吐き気 (はきけ, nausea).

items.q: 敵を欺くにはまず味方から、という表現があります。
items.qr: Teki o azamuku ni wa mazu mikata kara, to iu hyougen ga arimasu.
items.en: There's an expression: "to deceive the enemy, first deceive your own side."
items.hi: एक कहावत है: "दुश्मन को धोखा देने के लिए पहले अपने ही लोगों को धोखा दो।"
items.gu: એક કહેવત છે: "દુશ્મનને છેતરવા માટે પહેલા પોતાના જ લોકોને છેતરો."
items.why: Day 5's 欺 entry gives 欺く (あざむく, to deceive).

items.q: 少子化対策担当大臣が認可保育所を視察した。
items.qr: Shoushika taisaku tantou daijin ga ninka hoikusho o shisatsu shita.
items.en: The minister in charge of declining-birthrate countermeasures inspected a licensed daycare center.
items.hi: घटती जन्म-दर की रोकथाम के प्रभारी मंत्री ने एक मान्यता-प्राप्त डे-केयर का निरीक्षण किया।
items.gu: ઘટતા જન્મ દરના પ્રતિકારક પગલાં માટેના પ્રભારી મંત્રીએ માન્યતા પ્રાપ્ત ડે-કેર કેન્દ્રનું નિરીક્ષણ કર્યું.
items.why: Day 2's 策 entry lists ◆少子化対策 (measures against the declining birthrate) directly.

items.q: 救急搬送されたかんじゃが何軒もの病院で受け入れを拒否された。
items.qr: Kyuukyuu hansou sareta kanja ga nangen mo no byouin de ukeire o kyohi sareta.
items.en: A patient transported by ambulance was refused admission by numerous hospitals.
items.hi: एम्बुलेंस से लाए गए मरीज़ को कई अस्पतालों ने भर्ती करने से मना कर दिया।
items.gu: એમ્બ્યુલન્સથી લવાયેલા દર્દીને અનેક હોસ્પિટલોએ દાખલ કરવાની ના પાડી.
items.why: Day 4's 患 entry gives 患者 (かんじゃ, a patient) directly.

items.q: 働く母親の増加とともに保育園、たくじしょの需要が伸びている。
items.qr: Hataraku hahaoya no zouka to tomo ni hoikuen, takujisho no juyou ga nobite iru.
items.en: As the number of working mothers increases, demand for daycare centers and nurseries is growing.
items.hi: कामकाजी माँओं की संख्या बढ़ने के साथ, डे-केयर और शिशु-गृहों की माँग बढ़ रही है।
items.gu: કામ કરતી માતાઓની સંખ્યા વધવા સાથે, ડે-કેર અને પારણાઘરોની માંગ વધી રહી છે.
items.why: Day 4's 託 entry gives 託児所 (たくじしょ, a nursery school) directly.

items.q: 高齢化社会におけるしょうがい学習センターの意義は大きい。
items.qr: Koureika shakai ni okeru shougai gakushuu sentaa no igi wa ookii.
items.en: Lifelong-learning centers carry great significance in an aging society.
items.hi: वृद्धजनसंख्या वाले समाज में आजीवन-शिक्षा केंद्रों का बड़ा महत्व है।
items.gu: વૃદ્ધ વસ્તીવાળા સમાજમાં આજીવન-શિક્ષણ કેન્દ્રોનું ઘણું મહત્વ છે.
items.why: Day 4's ◆生涯学習 (lifelong learning) is the exact fixed phrase needed here.

items.q: ごみの不法投棄はしょばつされます。
items.qr: Gomi no fuhou touki wa shobatsu saremasu.
items.en: Illegal dumping of garbage is penalized.
items.hi: कचरे का ग़ैरक़ानूनी निपटान दंडनीय है।
items.gu: કચરાનો ગેરકાયદે નિકાલ સજાપાત્ર છે.
items.why: Day 5's 罰 entry gives 処罰 (しょばつ, to penalize) directly.

items.q: 野生の動物におそわれる事件が増えている。
items.qr: Yasei no doubutsu ni osowareru jiken ga fuete iru.
items.en: Incidents of being attacked by wild animals are increasing.
items.hi: जंगली जानवरों द्वारा हमला किए जाने की घटनाएँ बढ़ रही हैं।
items.gu: જંગલી પ્રાણીઓ દ્વારા હુમલો કરાવાના બનાવો વધી રહ્યા છે.
items.why: Day 5's 襲 entry gives 襲う → passive 襲われる (おそわれる, to be attacked), matching the book's own ◆クマに襲われる.

items.q: A市長選で当選の中山（ ）は、当選の喜びを次のように述べた。
items.qr: A-shichouusen de tousen no Nakayama (___) wa, tousen no yorokobi o tsugi no you ni nobeta.
items.en: Mr. Nakayama, elected in City A's mayoral race, described his joy at winning as follows.
items.hi: शहर A के मेयर चुनाव में विजयी श्री नाकायामा ने अपनी जीत की ख़ुशी को इस प्रकार बताया।
items.gu: શહેર Aની મેયર ચૂંટણીમાં વિજેતા શ્રી નાકાયામાએ પોતાની જીતની ખુશી આ રીતે વ્યક્ત કરી.
items.why: Day 1's 氏 entry (○○氏) is exactly the formal way newspapers refer to named people.

items.q: 世論調査で内閣の支持（ ）が低下していることがわかった。
items.qr: Yoron chousa de naikaku no shiji (___) ga teika shite iru koto ga wakatta.
items.en: A public opinion poll found that the cabinet's approval rating has declined.
items.hi: जनमत सर्वेक्षण से पता चला कि मंत्रिमंडल की समर्थन दर घट गई है।
items.gu: જનમત સર્વેક્ષણથી જાણવા મળ્યું કે મંત્રીમંડળનો સમર્થન દર ઘટ્યો છે.
items.why: Day 1's 関連語彙 gives 支持率 (しじりつ, approval rating) directly.

items.q: B県知事は報道（ ）の質問に終始笑顔で答えた。
items.qr: B-ken chiji wa houdou (___) no shitsumon ni shuushi egao de kotaeta.
items.en: The governor of Prefecture B answered the press corps' questions with a smile throughout.
items.hi: प्रांत B के गवर्नर ने पत्रकारों के सवालों का जवाब पूरी बातचीत में मुस्कुराते हुए दिया।
items.gu: પ્રાંત Bના ગવર્નરે પત્રકારોના સવાલોના જવાબ આખી વાતચીતમાં હસતાં હસતાં આપ્યા.
items.why: Day 1's 陣 entry gives 報道陣 (ほうどうじん, the assembled press), matching the book's own ◆報道陣に囲まれる.

items.q: 今回の選挙では保守（ ）が優勢とみられている。
items.qr: Konkai no senkyo de wa hoshu (___) ga yuusei to mirarete iru.
items.en: In this election, the conservative faction is seen as having the advantage.
items.hi: इस चुनाव में रूढ़िवादी/परंपरावादी गुट को बढ़त मिलने की संभावना है।
items.gu: આ ચૂંટણીમાં રૂઢિચુસ્ત જૂથને ફાયદો મળવાની શક્યતા છે.
items.why: Day 1's 派 entry gives 保守派 (the conservative faction), directly opposite 革新派 (the reformist faction).

items.q: 新聞の投書（ ）に投稿する。
items.qr: Shinbun no toushou (___) ni toukou suru.
items.en: Submit a piece to the newspaper's letters-to-the-editor column.
items.hi: अख़बार के पाठक-पत्र स्तंभ में लेख भेजना।
items.gu: અખબારના વાચક-પત્ર વિભાગમાં લખાણ મોકલવું.
items.why: Day 6's 欄 entry gives 投書欄 (とうしょらん, the letters-to-the-editor section) directly.
